  • Creating new solutions and inspiring others.   
  • Establishing a track record of success 
  • Executing consistently and finding ways to add new value 
  • Your ability to adapt to change and work under pressure while maintaining your safety, quality and efficiency
  • Entegris is a values-driven culture and our employees rally around our core PACE values (People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence). In this position our expectation if for you to collaborate with People, maintain Accountability of yourself and your tasks and a dedication to Excellence in your performance.

jobs.title: Manager, Materials Quality Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Manager, Materials Quality Engineering

Job Description:

Manager, Materials Quality Engineering

We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking Manager of Materials Quality Engineering (MQE), based in the Suwon office, to lead a regional team of individuals supporting critical raw materials and supplier quality activities across chemistry (organic and inorganic) and gas commodities. This role will provide people leadership, technical direction, and strategic oversight for team members in Korea, Taiwan, and China, strengthening a prevention-focused quality culture while ensuring strong execution across the four MQE pillars: Supplier Management, Raw Material Management, Management of Change, and New Product Development.

The MQE Manager will lead a team and partner closely with Korea operations, regional MQE teams, Procurement, Operations, R&D, Customer Quality, and suppliers to drive robust material performance, disciplined change control, proactive risk mitigation, and aligned support for regional manufacturing and global MQE priorities.

Key Responsibilities

People Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a regional team of Materials Quality Engineers supporting chemistry and gas commodities across Korea, Taiwan, and China.

  • Manage and support employees located both in-person and remote, ensuring inclusive communication, balanced workload distribution, and effective collaboration with local plants and global partners.

  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning.

  • Build technical capability through structured training, mentorship, and knowledge sharing across chemistry, gas, supplier quality, and raw material management disciplines.

  • Promote collaboration, clear communication, and trust.

MQE Pillar Leadership

  • Engage and influence Korea operations, Taiwan and China team members, global MQE partners, business stakeholders, Procurement, R&D, Customer Quality, and suppliers to build alignment, clarify decision rights, and drive timely execution across all pillars.

  • Communicate clearly and respectfully, translating complex technical and program information into concise, actionable insights tailored to engineers, leadership, suppliers, and customers.

  • Provide technical guidance on investigations and prevention across chemistry and gas commodities, including failure analysis, root cause, SPC, FMEA, control plans, and risk mitigation.

  • Represent MQE as a steady, credible, and solutions‑oriented leader during audits, escalations, supplier reviews, and cross‑functional forums, ensuring a consistent voice and disciplined follow-through.

  • Ensure consistent MQE support for Korea-based operations and regional supplier quality needs across Korea, Taiwan, and China, balancing local responsiveness with global standards and commodity alignment.

Execution & Governance

  • Establish the operating rhythm to manage performance, risk, and improvement across the four MQE pillars for Korea operations and regional chemistry and gas supplier quality support.

  • Ensure timely reporting of status, risks, and deliverables, escalating issues early and enabling fact-based decisions.

  • Deploy best‑practice program management frameworks to drive cross-functional alignment, accountability, and on-time execution.

External Engagement

  • Serve as an escalation point for supplier investigations, excursions, audits, and customer-facing quality issues tied to Korea-, Taiwan-, and China-supported chemistry and gas raw materials, ensuring disciplined containment, communication, and closure.

  • Ensure high-quality external communication packages (technical reports, OCAPs, 8Ds, and presentations) that align to customer expectations and internal standards.

  • Lead supplier quality engagements for chemistry and gas commodities, including corrective and preventive actions, audit readiness, process capability reviews, and sustained closure of systemic issues.

Quality Systems & Operational Excellence

  • Ensure compliance with global quality policies, raw material control plans, supplier quality expectations, and management of change requirements across Korea-, Taiwan-, and China-supported chemistry and gas materials.

  • Maintain zero‑overdue CAR, OFIs, OCAPs, or CRs.

  • Monitor and improve key performance indicators (e.g., OOC%, QN/NCMR cycle time, SPC maturity, EQOS, change cycle time, and investigation timeliness) and drive corrective action when performance drifts.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred.

  • 10+ years industry experience; 3+ years people leadership required.

  • Fluency in Korean and English required; additional fluency in Mandarin or another regional language is a plus.

  • Experience managing employees across multiple locations and collaborating across global, cross-functional teams preferred.

  • Strong understanding of SPC, FMEA, supplier quality systems, materials characterization, chemistry, gas manufacturing, specialty gases, and raw material process controls. Six Sigma Green Belt desired.

  • Proficiency with Minitab, JMP, SAS, SAP, Power BI, Microsoft Office.

Travel: Up to 20%, including travel between Korea operations, regional team locations in Taiwan and China, suppliers, and regional/global meetings as needed.

jobs.title: Chemistry Technician II
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Chemistry Technician II

Job Description:

📌주요역할개요 (Role Overview)

장안공장에서 SPI 생산을 지원하는 분석실 (Analytical Lab) Technician을 모집합니다.
본 포지션은 분석 장비 운영을 담당하며, 정해진 절차에 따라 Chemical원자재, 공정중샘플, 최종제품의분석을정확하게수행 합니다.

이 포지션에 채용된 인원에게는 분석장비 운영과 더불어, 기술 역량을 확장하고, 성장하는 조직 내에서 역동적인 팀과 함께 일할 수 있는 기회를 제공합니다. (근무시간: 주간 근무07:00 ~ 16:00 / 오후 근무 16:00~23:00)

🧪주요업무 (What You’ll Do)

  • ICP-MS, ICP-OES, HPLC, IC,GC, Titrator 등의 분석 장비를 사용하여 샘플의 화학적/물리적분석을수행 (정기 및 비정기 샘플 포함)
  • 데이터 신뢰성 및 제조 공정 변동성에 영향을 줄 수 있는 사항 발생 시 즉시 Supervisor 및 Manager에게보고
  • 분석 장비 및 시료 채취 장비의 일반유지보수및교정수행 (Calibration Program 준수)
  • Chemist와 협력하여 장비 문제 해결(Troubleshooting), MSA 및 Method Validation 관련 테스트 수행
  • 안전지침준수및개선 (5S 활동포함)
  • 이상 결과(OOS: Out of Specification 또는 트렌드 벗어남) 발생 시 이를 인지하고 Lab Supervisor 지시에따라조사수행

🎯지원자격 (What We Seek)

  • 결과 중심적이며 디테일에 강하고, 팀워크 능력이 뛰어난 인재
  • 화학 및 실험실 관리 기준(GLP), 반도체 소재 중요성에 대한 이해 보유자
  • 전문학사이상 / 분석화학또는관련전공학사우대
  • 화학 제조 환경에서 2년이상의실무경험및분석장비사용경험
    (ICP-MS, ICP-OES, HPLC, IC,GC, Titrator등)
  • 화학물질의 안전한 취급 및 폐기 능력, 안전하고청결한작업환경유지능력
  • 복잡한샘플매트릭스에대한샘플전처리경험
  • 위험 화학 물질 환경에서 안전기준준수필수
  • 멀티태스킹 및 시간관리 능력
  • 세밀함과 체계적인 업무 수행 능력
  • MS Office 등 기본 컴퓨터 활용 능력

🌟우대사항 (Outstanding Candidates)

  • 다음 장비 일부 또는 전부에 대한 운영 및 유지보수 경험
    👉 ICP-MS, ICP-OES, HPLC, IC,GC, Titrator
  • 분석 데이터 자동화를 위한 장비소프트웨어운용능력
  • 화학/가스 제조 환경 근무 경험 (Cleanroom 내 분석실 에서 근무)
  • 자기주도적이며 커뮤니케이션 능력이 뛰어난 인재
  • 다양한 조직과 협업하며 문제 해결이 가능한 분

jobs.title: Specialist, Accounting & Treasury (Entegris Singapore Korea Branch)
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Specialist, Accounting & Treasury (Entegris Singapore Korea Branch)

Job Description:

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Accountant, Accounting & Treasury to provide support for Entegris Singapore Korea Branch and closely cooperate with local finance to support cash management. This role works closely with Singapore Finance, local finance , and Corporate Treasury across the region.

This position is responsible for all monthly closing activities as well as quarterly VAT filing and annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) filing for Entegris Singapore Korea Branch (50%), reporting directly to a Singapore-based manager. The role also supports treasury and cash management, intercompany settlements, audits, and ad-hoc tasks and projects to drive standardization and automation for Entegris Korea (50%), with a dotted-line report to the Korea Finance Manager.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Tax Compliance (Entegris Singapore Korea Branch) – Reports Directly to Singapore-based Manager

  • Perform accounting for Entegris Singapore Korea Branch.
  • Perform all monthly closing activities, including BlackLine reconciliations and bank reconciliations, as well as quarter-end and year-end closing.
  • Prepare journal entries, accruals, and prepaid expense amortization.
  • Perform balance sheet account reconciliations and analyze fluctuations.
  • Manage closing tasks using SAP and BlackLine.
  • Perform accounting for Korea VAT compliance, ensuring accurate recording of input and output VAT.
  • Prepare and file quarterly VAT returns.
  • Prepare and support the annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) filing in coordination with external tax advisors.
  • Reconcile VAT and tax accounts to the general ledger.

Treasury & Cash Management (Entegris Korea 4174/4178) – Dotted-Line Report to Korea Finance Manager

  • Manage CitiDirect user access and authorizations to ensure the safety and security of banking transactions.
  • Report foreign exchange transactions to the designated foreign exchange bank (CITI) and the Bank of Korea, depending on the nature of the transactions (e.g., third-party netting declarations, netting declarations, cylinder lease filings, and intercompany loans with foreign affiliates).
  • Update daily bank statements and review and clear open items in FEBAN.
  • Execute weekly purchases and sales of foreign currency.
  • Review foreign currency assets and liabilities and analyze the FX position to understand the impact of external factors on foreign exchange fluctuations.
  • Regularly prepare cash forecasts and closely monitor tight cash positions.
  • Process vendor payments, intercompany settlements, and fund transfers in accordance with approval policies.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with CITI and monitor compliance to prevent any violation of the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act.

Intercompany Coordination & Internal Control

  • Reconcile intercompany balances and resolve differences with counterparties.
  • Support intercompany charges, cross-charges, and settlement processes.
  • Collaborate with Corporate Finance, Corporate Treasury, and local finance teams.
  • Execute internal control activities for accounting and treasury processes.
  • Follow up on audit findings and support corrective actions.

Process Excellence & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual journal entries and improve closing efficiency.
  • Support standardization of accounting and treasury processes.
  • Leverage Copilot / Power Platform and Excel tools to automate routine tasks.

Project Support

  • Participate in Entegris Singapore Korea Branch and Regional Finance projects.
  • Support SAP enhancements and system changes.
  • Support ad-hoc tasks and projects as requested.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 5–10 years of experience in accounting and/or treasury.
  • Solid understanding of month-end closing and balance sheet reconciliation.
  • Hands-on experience with cash management, payments, and bank reconciliations.
  • Working knowledge of Korean VAT and Corporate Income Tax (CIT) compliance.
  • Experience using SAP and AI skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English.

Preferred

  • Experience in a multinational or shared service environment.
  • Experience in manufacturing or the semiconductor industry.
  • Knowledge of US GAAP and intercompany accounting.
  • Experience with BlackLine or process automation tools.

Why Work at Entegris

Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future. Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort as we realize there are leaders at every level of the organization. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. We want the time and energy you spend here to have a positive impact on your life inside and outside of the office.

What We Offer

Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals.

  • Generous 401(K) plan with an impressive employer match
  • Excellent health, dental and vision insurance packages to fit your needs
  • Flexible work schedule and 11 paid holidays a year
  • Paid time off (PTO) policy that empowers you to take the time you need to recharge
  • Education assistance to support your learning journey
  • Values-driven culture with colleagues that rally around People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence

Entegris does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Entegris immigration sponsorship (e.g., H1B, TN, STEM OPT, etc.) now or in the future.


At Entegris we are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital or military status.

jobs.title: Cleanroom Technician
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Cleanroom Technician

Job Description:

The Role: Cleanroom Technician

We are seeking a Cleanroom Technician to join our team in KTC, Korea. In this role you will perform technical tests and experiments for process engineering within R&D. You will also process test runs and prepare records, charts, and graphs of results for presentation to the engineering team to identify yield problems or test new products.


In this role you will:

  • Owns experiment preparation activities, including wafer preparation (measurements - thickness and defects), log sheet preparation, recipe preparation
  • Handles set-up and operation of polishers (Ebara) cleaners and wafer metrology tools
  • Conducts polishing experiments using blanket and patterned wafers
  • Performs process and equipment troubleshooting activities during experiments, including identification of sources of polish variation
  • Guides and provides recommendations to polish experiment feasibility and design based on hands-on experience
  • Slurry sample preparation for CMP experiments with raw materials inventory management
  • Actively participate in planning and execution of internal Cleanroom and product line based continuous improvement activities
  • Acts as a resource and collaborator with Engineers and Scientists
  • Shares in responsibility for the safety of shift-coworkers

Traits we believe make a strong candidate:

Education & Experience

  • Associate degree in an Engineering field required. Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering field is preferred
  • Proven knowledge and experience in CMP preferred
  • Experience working on engineering projects, or equivalent, required
  • Defectivity metrology experience a plus.

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to operate in a highly independent manner, tolerance of ambiguity, strong skills in planning and organization, attention to detail, strong teamwork and communication skills.
  • Microsoft Office applications skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) required
  • Statistical analysis software skills a plus (JMP, Minitab, SAS)
  • Ability to work shifts required.
  • Own vehicle preferred.

jobs.title: EHS Sr. Specialist, FSE & Sales Support
jobs.description:
Job Title:

EHS Sr. Specialist, FSE & Sales Support

Job Description:

The Role:

This role reports to the Manager, Site EHS, Korea, and supports safe and compliant execution of Korea Field Service and customer-facing activities. The position serves as the primary EHS partner for Field Service, Sales, customer Supplier Assessments, and customer EHS audits. It also provides baseline EHS governance for the Suwon Office. The role works closely with Korea EHS, FSE, Sales, Global EHS, Global FSE, and customer EHS teams, and requires regular travel to customer sites in Korea.


Indicative scope: FSE support and customer assessments 60% | Sales support 30% | Office EHS 10%


In this role you will:

FSE & Field EHS

  • • Act as the primary EHS contact and owner for FSE-related customer requirements, including customer Supplier Assessments, EHS audits, and customer EHS meetings.
  • • Lead or support field risk assessments, joint inspections, PPE compliance, and high-risk work controls, and reinforce Stop Work Authority at customer sites.
  • • Prepare and validate audit evidence, including training, risk assessment, PPE, incident, and corrective action records.
  • • Support incident and near-miss investigations and escalate significant risks to Korea EHS and FSE leadership.
  • • Coordinate customer communication and drive audit and inspection findings and preventive actions to effective closure.

Sales, Pre-Sales & Contract Support

  • Interpret customer EHS requirements and identify feasibility, resource, cost, and compliance risks before commitment.
  • Provide EHS input for customer presentations, quotations, contracts, EHS addendums, and service agreements.
  • Define EHS assumptions, responsibility boundaries, and required mitigation plans with Sales, Legal, and FSE.
  • Support Sales in customers' annual supplier evaluations, including EHS-related responses to RBA and ESG questionnaires, preparation of supporting evidence, and on-site assessment readiness and response, and follow up on EHS-related findings and improvement actions.

Training & Competency

  • Manage statutory training under the Korean Occupational Safety and Health Act (new-hire, pre-assignment / job-change, regular, and special safety training), including scheduling, completion tracking, and records.
  • Develop and maintain an FSE EHS training matrix based on legal, customer, and Entegris requirements.
  • Coordinate FSE training on MSDS, electrical, gas, chemical, LOTO, PPE, customer requirements, and new-hire safety.
  • Verify training effectiveness through assessments, practical demonstrations, field observations, and ride-along reviews.

Occupational Health

  • Manage pre-placement and special health exams, including scheduling, result review, and follow-up.
  • Coordinate work environment monitoring, review results, and follow up on required exposure-control improvements.

Suwon Office EHS

  • Conduct periodic office safety inspections and coordinate emergency drills and fire safety checks with building management.
  • Support office incident reporting, corrective actions, minimum regulatory compliance, and escalation of serious risks.

Management Systems & Improvement

  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready EHS records and support applicable RBA and Corporate EHS requirements.
  • Monitor FSE EHS performance, identify recurring gaps, and share lessons learned and good practices.

Traits we believe make a strong candidate:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in safety, Environmental, Industrial, Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 7~10 years of relevant EHS experience, preferably supporting field service, semiconductor customers, equipment installation, or maintenance activities.
  • Working knowledge of Korean EHS regulations and practical experience in risk assessments, audits, incident investigations, training, and corrective action management.
  • Ability to interpret customer requirements and translate them into practical field controls.
  • Effective Korean communication and working-level English; proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Ability and willingness to travel regularly to customer and Entegris locations in Korea.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certification such as Industrial Safety Engineer, Industrial Hygiene Engineer, Gas Engineer, or Hazardous Materials Engineer.
  • Experience with customer Supplier Assessments, contractor safety management, and semiconductor field service.
  • Knowledge of electrical safety, hazardous energy control, chemical and gas safety, PPE, and defensive driving programs.
  • Experience working in a multinational or cross-functional matrix organization.

Key Competencies

  • Customer focus with sound regulatory and operational judgment.
  • Hands-on risk identification, problem solving, ownership, and action closure.
  • Ability to influence across functions without direct authority.
  • Clear communication, documentation discipline, and willingness to challenge unsafe conditions.

jobs.title: Manager, Site EHS
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Manager, Site EHS

Job Description:

The Role:

This role reports to the Senior Manager, Site EHS, Korea, and serves as the EHS leader for the JangAn Plant, responsible for managing and continuously improving the site EHS program with primary emphasis on Health & Safety risk management. The Manager leads the JangAn EHS team and partners with site leadership, cross-functional teams, contractors, Korea EHS, and Corporate EHS to ensure compliance with Korean laws and regulations, ISO 14001 / ISO 45001, RBA, and Entegris Corporate EHS standards.


This position is located at the JangAn Plant, Hwaseong-si, Gyeonggi-do, Korea.


In this role you will:

JangAn Site EHS Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and develop the JangAn EHS team by setting clear roles and annual priorities, allocating resources, and coaching team members.
  • Own the site EHS management system and report EHS performance, compliance, and risks to site and Korea EHS leadership.
  • Partner with site leadership to strengthen EHS accountability, employee engagement, and a practical safety culture.

Legal & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with Korean EHS laws and regulations, including the Occupational Safety and Health Act and the Serious Accidents Punishment Act, covering required appointments, inspections, records, and regulatory reporting.
  • Keep all permits, licenses, registrations, and regulatory notifications for JangAn Plant operations current, including timely change notifications and renewals.
  • Coordinate responses to government inspections and close identified compliance gaps in a timely manner.

Occupational Health & Safety and Critical Risk Management

  • Lead the site Occupational Health & Safety program, including risk assessment, industrial hygiene, ergonomics, and contractor safety.
  • Ensure robust implementation of critical risk controls, including LOTO, permit-to-work, hot work, confined space entry, work at height, electrical and chemical safety, and Stop Work Authority.
  • Manage toxic specialty gas safety, including gas cabinets, cylinder change-outs, leak detection and alarms, emergency shutdown, and gas leak response readiness.
  • Oversee statutory safety and health training and occupational health programs, including health examinations, work environment monitoring, and exposure controls.
  • Lead incident and near-miss investigations, including root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and lessons-learned sharing.

Environmental, Chemical & Sustainability Governance

  • Oversee air, water, waste, chemical, hazardous material, and emergency-response programs with clear technical ownership within the site EHS team.
  • Ensure operations meet environmental permit conditions through emission and effluent monitoring, waste tracking, inspections, and accurate records, while supporting sustainability objectives.

Projects, Change Management & Operational Readiness

  • Integrate EHS requirements into new equipment, process changes, and facility projects through MOC, PHA / HAZOP, and PSSR reviews, in partnership with the Korea PSM/Project lead.
  • Ensure contractor and project activities are executed with appropriate risk controls, permits, competency verification, and field oversight.

Management Systems, Audits & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain and improve ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 management systems and support RBA conformance.
  • Coordinate internal, customer, regulatory, and corporate audits and drive findings to effective closure.
  • Collaborate with Korea and Asia EHS teams to standardize programs and share best practices.

Traits we believe make a strong candidate:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Safety, Environmental, Occupational Health, or Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Qualified for statutory appointment as Safety Manager (안전관리자) under the Occupational Safety and Health Act, e.g., 산업안전기사 / 산업안전산업기사 or higher.
  • 10+ years of progressive EHS experience in manufacturing, including people leadership and site-level EHS governance.
  • Practical expertise in Korean occupational safety and health regulations, critical risk controls, incident investigation, and risk assessment.
  • Experience maintaining ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 management systems and supporting RBA, customer, regulatory, or corporate audits.
  • Fluent spoken English, with proven experience presenting and reporting EHS topics to regional and global stakeholders, along with strong Korean communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and EHS reporting systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Gas Engineer (가스기사) or Hazardous Materials Industrial Engineer (위험물산업기사) certification or equivalent, with experience in chemical, specialty gas, semiconductor, or other high-hazard manufacturing.
  • Experience supporting MOC, PHA / HAZOP, PSSR, capital projects, and startup readiness.

Key Competencies

  • Team development, prioritization, coaching, and accountability management.
  • Hands-on risk identification, analytical problem solving, ownership, and disciplined action closure.
  • Ability to influence leadership and cross-functional stakeholders and escalate significant risks promptly.
  • Clear communication, sound regulatory and operational judgment, and willingness to challenge unsafe conditions.

jobs.title: Engineer II, Manufacturing Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Engineer II, Manufacturing Engineering

Job Description:

THE ROLE:

We are seeking a Maintenance Engineer to strengthen equipment reliability and establish disciplined maintenance engineering processes across manufacturing operations at the Munmak site in Korea, supporting the Advanced Purity Solutions Division.


This position will complement the site’s strong hands-on maintenance capability by bringing structured engineering practices to preventive and predictive maintenance, equipment changes management, technical documentation, spare-parts management, root cause analysis, validation, and equipment improvement.


The role requires a balance of practical equipment knowledge and strong engineering process execution. You will work closely with experienced maintenance personnel, Manufacturing Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, EHS, equipment suppliers, and other cross-functional teams to convert field knowledge into standardized, documented, and sustainable maintenance systems and transition maintenance from reactive support toward systematic equipment reliability

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve preventive and predictive maintenance programs for manufacturing equipment, facilities interfaces, and automation systems.
  • Monitor equipment performance and analyze downtime, MTBF, MTTR, OEE, preventive maintenance compliance, and repeat-failure trends to identify reliability improvement opportunities.
  • Lead structured root cause analysis for critical, chronic, and recurring equipment failures and implement permanent corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage equipment modifications and improvements through applicable company change-management and engineering review processes, ensuring changes are evaluated, approved, documented, implemented, validated, communicated, and formally closed.
  • Prepare and maintain controlled engineering documentation including equipment specifications, drawings, BOMs, manuals, PM standards, troubleshooting guides, equipment history, maintenance records, validation evidence, and technical reports.
  • Convert maintenance experience and field knowledge into standardized maintenance procedures, inspection checklists, troubleshooting standards, training materials, and technical documentation.
  • Establish equipment criticality and risk-based maintenance priorities focusing resources on equipment with the greatest impact on safety, quality, production, and business continuity.
  • Develop and maintain critical spare-parts strategies based on equipment criticality, failure history, component lifecycle, lead time, and production risk.
  • Coordinate equipment improvement and change activities with Manufacturing Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, EHS, suppliers, and contractors.
  • Support troubleshooting of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, control, sensor, motor, servo, robotic, and automation equipment as applicable.
  • Support new equipment introduction including technical reviews, installation, FAT/SAT, commissioning, qualification, and formal handover into the maintenance system.
  • Ensure new and modified equipment is incorporated into PM programs, spare-parts requirements, equipment documentation, training, and maintenance history before closure.
  • Lead or support reliability and equipment improvement projects aimed at reducing unplanned downtime, repetitive failures, maintenance response time, and operational risk.
  • Apply structured methodologies including RCA, 5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA, TPM, and data-based failure analysis to maintenance and equipment problems.
  • Coordinate technical activities with external equipment suppliers and contractors and ensure work, safety controls, deliverables, and documentation meet applicable company requirements.
  • Support equipment-related CAPEX and improvement projects by defining maintainability, reliability, spare-part, lifecycle, documentation, and maintenance requirements.
  • Promote disciplined execution of company processes including engineering documentation, action tracking, change control, safety review, equipment validation, training, and timely action closure.

What We Seek:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics, automation, control engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in manufacturing equipment maintenance, equipment engineering, reliability engineering, automation, or industrial equipment support.
  • Practical understanding of manufacturing equipment including mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, sensor, motor, servo, or automation systems.
  • Strong understanding of preventive maintenance, equipment troubleshooting, failure analysis, and equipment reliability principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage technical documentation, engineering changes, improvement activities, and project actions in a structured manner.
  • Ability to manage engineering work from problem identification through technical review, approval, implementation, validation, documentation, training, and closure.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to documentation accuracy, follow-up, data integrity, and procedural compliance.
  • Effective cross-functional communication skills with the ability to coordinate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, EHS, technicians, suppliers, and contractors.
  • Basic data analysis and computer skills, including Microsoft Excel and electronic maintenance or engineering records.
  • Strong ownership with the ability to balance immediate equipment needs with long-term reliability and system improvements.

Outstanding candidates will have:

  • Experience with formal engineering change management, MOC, equipment change control, or equipment validation processes.
  • Experience building or improving preventive or predictive maintenance programs rather than only performing reactive repairs.
  • Working knowledge of CMMS, SAP maintenance systems, equipment history databases, or other digital maintenance management systems.
  • Experience analyzing MTBF, MTTR, OEE, downtime, PM compliance, and repeat-failure data.
  • Experience with PLC/HMI, servo systems, industrial robots, sensors, pneumatic systems, automated manufacturing equipment, or related control technologies.
  • Experience managing equipment BOMs, critical spare parts, lifecycle risks, obsolescence, and supplier technical support.
  • Experience supporting equipment installation, FAT/SAT, commissioning, qualification, validation, or manufacturing release.
  • Knowledge of TPM, Reliability-Centered Maintenance, FMEA, structured RCA, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience in semiconductor, high-purity fluid handling, precision manufacturing, injection molding, CNC machining, automated assembly, cleanroom, or another highly controlled manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate hands-on maintenance knowledge into standardized systems, controlled documentation, and sustainable engineering processes.

jobs.title: Engineer, Wet Etch Formulation
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Engineer, Wet Etch Formulation

Job Description:

The Role:

  • Entegris is seeking an Engineer I to support wet chemical formulation and process development for advanced semiconductor applications at the Korea Technology Center in Ansan. 
  • This entry-level role works within a global project team to execute laboratory experiments, analyze data, and support the development and integration of new wet etch and cleaning solutions that address customer process needs. 
  • The Engineer I will learn and apply established engineering and scientific methods under the guidance of experienced engineers and scientists, while building effective working relationships with colleagues in Korea and global technology centers.

In this role you will:

  • Execute wet chemical formulation preparation, screening, and optimization experiments by following established procedures and project plans. 
  • Support semiconductor wet process evaluations, including coupon or wafer preparation, chemical treatment, basic process testing, and sample handling. 
  • Collect, organize, and analyze experimental data using standard tools; summarize results and identify observations that require further review. 
  • Maintain accurate laboratory notebooks, test records, chemical inventories, and technical documentation in accordance with quality and EHS requirements. 
  • Operate and maintain assigned laboratory equipment after completing required training, and promptly report equipment or process abnormalities. 
  • Collaborate with formulation scientists, application engineers, analytical teams, manufacturing, product management, and customer-facing teams to support project execution. 
  • Prepare clear technical summaries and presentations for project reviews; communicate progress, results, and issues to the project team. 
  • Support project milestones, sample preparation, technology transfer, and New Product Introduction activities as assigned. 
  • Contribute ideas for improving experimental efficiency, data quality, laboratory workflows, and product performance. 
  • Maintain a safe working environment and comply with all company safety, chemical-handling, and environmental procedures. 
  • Travel up to 10%, including visits to other technology centers, suppliers, or customer sites as business needs require. 
  • Support formulation scale-up and sampling activities, including preparation, labeling, documentation, and coordination of samples for internal evaluation and customer testing. 

Traits we believe make a strong candidate:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, mechanical Engineering or a closely related technical field. 
  • Entry-level candidate or recent graduate; prior industrial experience is not required. Relevant internship, undergraduate research, or laboratory project experience is preferred. 
  • Basic understanding of chemical engineering principles, wet chemistry, reaction kinetics, mass transfer, materials compatibility, or semiconductor processing. 
  • Hands-on laboratory experience with chemical solution preparation, experimental execution, safe chemical handling, and data recording. 
  • Ability to follow standard practices and procedures, analyze readily available data, and make recommendations based on defined guidelines and precedent. 
  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving ability, learning agility, and accountability for assigned work. 
  • Ability to communicate and work effectively with immediate supervisors, project leaders, and cross-functional team members. 
  • Working-level English skills for technical documentation and communication with global teams. 
  • Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; familiarity with statistical analysis or data-visualization tools is a plus. 
  • Ability and willingness to work a shift-based schedule as required to support laboratory operations, scale-up, and sampling activities. 

Your success will be measured by:

  • Safe and compliant execution: Consistently follows EHS, chemical-handling, laboratory, and documentation requirements. 
  • Technical execution and data quality: Completes assigned experiments accurately, on schedule, and with reliable, traceable data. 
  • Learning and problem solving: Builds wet chemical and semiconductor process knowledge and applies feedback to improve experimental work. 
  • Teamwork and communication: Collaborates effectively, communicates progress and issues clearly, and supports shared project goals. 
  • Accountability: Takes ownership of assigned tasks, follows through on commitments, and escalates risks or uncertainties promptly. 
  • Continuous improvement and creativity: Contributes practical ideas that improve product performance, test methods, or laboratory efficiency.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Wet Etch Formulation
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Senior Scientist, Wet Etch Formulation

Job Description:

The Role:

  • Entegris is seeking a Senior Scientist, Wet Etch Formulation to develop differentiated wet etch and cleaning chemistries for advanced semiconductor applications. In this role, you will apply deep expertise in chemistry and materials science to establish composition–property–performance relationships, propose and validate mechanisms of etching and cleaning, and translate fundamental understanding into robust formulations. 
  • The Scientist will own major technical workstreams within development programs, design statistically sound experiments, analyze complex data, and define clear next-step recommendations. The role will collaborate closely with global R&D, analytical, process engineering, scale-up, manufacturing, product management, and customer-facing teams to move concepts from laboratory screening through wafer validation, sampling, and customer evaluation. 

In this role you will:

  • Lead the design and development of wet etch and cleaning formulations for advanced semiconductor materials and process applications. 
  • Build fundamental understanding of formulation composition, reaction kinetics, selectivity, etch rate, surface condition, residue removal, and materials compatibility. 
  • Design and execute laboratory studies to screen acids, bases, oxidizers, inhibitors, chelators, surfactants, solvents, and other functional additives while maintaining safe chemical-handling practices. 
  • Develop and test hypotheses regarding reaction and inhibition mechanisms using analytical characterization, statistically robust experimental designs, and literature or patent review. 
  • Partner with process and application engineers to evaluate formulation performance using coupons, patterned wafers, and full-wafer tests, and establish correlation across laboratory and wafer-scale results. 
  • Analyze experimental outcomes using statistical tools and use the results to prioritize formulation changes, process conditions, and subsequent experiments. 
  • Assess formulation robustness, including chemical stability, bath life, temperature sensitivity, materials compatibility, filtration, contamination control, and reproducibility. 
  • Support formulation scale-up, purification, mixing, filtration, chemical delivery, sample preparation, and technology transfer in collaboration with engineering and manufacturing teams. 
  • Prepare technical presentations, development reports, invention disclosures, and customer-facing data packages; communicate results and risks clearly to global R&D peers and cross-functional partners. 
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, contribute to project planning, and promote a rigorous safety-first and data-driven R&D culture. 

Traits we believe make a strong candidate:

  • MS or PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physical Chemistry, Electrochemistry, Surface Science, or a closely related field. 
  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience with a PhD or 7 years with an MS in wet chemical formulation, semiconductor process chemistry, surface treatment, etching, cleaning, or a related field. 
  • Strong ability to design, execute, and analyze experiments that elucidate chemical functions, reaction mechanisms, selectivity, or surface interactions. 
  • Experience in simulation and modeling of chemical reactions, transport phenomena, surface interactions, or semiconductor wet processes is preferred.
  • Experience with analytical and surface-characterization methods used to assess composition, etch performance, residues, defects, or surface condition is preferred. 
  • Hands-on experience with corrosive wet chemistries and functional additives such as acids, bases, oxidizers, inhibitors, chelators, surfactants, or solvents. 
  • Knowledge of semiconductor materials and their chemical behavior, including metals, metal oxides, silicon-based materials, dielectrics, and photoresist-related residues, is preferred. 
  • Working knowledge of design of experiments, statistical data analysis, and data visualization for formulation optimization and process-window definition. 
  • Demonstrated independence in leading technical projects and working effectively with analytical, process engineering, scale-up, manufacturing, and customer-facing teams. 
  • Clear written and verbal English communication skills for collaboration with global teams and preparation of technical presentations and reports. 
  • Strong commitment to EHS, chemical risk assessment, disciplined documentation, and a safety-first laboratory culture. 

Your success will be measured by:

  • Delivers differentiated wet etch and cleaning formulations that meet defined performance, selectivity, compatibility, stability, and safety requirements. 
  • Creates high-quality, traceable data and converts experimental results into clear technical decisions and efficient next-step plans. 
  • Builds mechanistic understanding and robust composition–process–performance relationships that shorten learning cycles and improve formulation quality. 
  • Achieves project milestones through effective prioritization, technical ownership, risk escalation, and cross-functional execution. 
  • Supports successful wafer validation, scale-up, sampling, technology transfer, and customer evaluation with complete and credible technical documentation. 
  • Demonstrates creativity, collaboration, technical leadership, and consistent adherence to a safety-first culture.

jobs.title: Director of Markets and Technology
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Director of Markets and Technology

Job Description:

The Role

Entegris is currently seeking a Director of Markets and Technology to join our Molecular & Engineered Solutions team. This position will be based in our Ansan, Korea facility.

Entegris is seeking an experienced Director of Markets and Technology to drive growth within the Molecular and Engineered Solutions business. This strategic leadership role will identify, evaluate, qualify, and commercialize new opportunities across advanced semiconductor manufacturing markets. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in ALD, CVD, and etch processes with strong commercial acumen and the ability to translate customer needs and market signals into profitable growth initiatives. The director will partner with customers, sales, R&D, applications engineering, product management, and executive leadership to shape technology roadmaps, prioritize investments, and accelerate adoption of next-generation materials and process solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Prioritize markets, customer segments, technology platforms, and growth opportunities based on strategic fit and commercial potential.
  • Lead opportunity assessment, creation, qualification, and commercialization across semiconductor deposition and etch markets.
  • Develop and manage a robust opportunity pipeline aligned with long-term growth objectives.
  • Capture and translate customer signals and Voice of Customer (VOC) insights into actionable opportunities and product requirements.
  • Conduct competitive analysis, including SWOT assessments, to identify sustainable competitive advantages and market differentiators.
  • Lead Business Opportunity Reviews (BORs) to support prioritization, resource allocation, and investment decisions.
  • Recommend investments related to product portfolio expansion, technology development, and resource allocation.
  • Influence pricing, rebate, and commercialization strategies for new and existing products.
  • Sequence and resource initiatives in alignment with technology roadmaps and strategic growth objectives.
  • Build executive-level relationships with semiconductor device designers, manufacturers, foundries, memory customers, and equipment partners.
  • Identify and collaborate with external partners (universities, consortia and the wider semiconductor materials and hardware industry) to create new and differentiated material solutions.
  • Provide clear strategic guidance in uncertain, ambiguous, and competing situations.
  • Represent Entegris in customer engagements, industry conferences, and strategic business reviews.

What We Seek

  • Master’s degree in engineering, materials science, chemistry, physics, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of semiconductor industry experience in business development, product management, strategic marketing, applications engineering, process development, or a related role.
  • Strong technical understanding of atomic layer deposition (ALD), chemical vapor deposition (CVD), plasma-enhanced CVD (PECVD), dry/plasma etch processes, and semiconductor materials and process chemistries.
  • Demonstrated success developing growth strategies, qualifying opportunities, and advancing new products or technologies toward commercialization.
  • Experience conducting VOC, market assessments, opportunity reviews, competitive analysis, and SWOT analysis.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including experience supporting portfolio investment, pricing, rebate, and commercialization decisions.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, executive communication, presentation, and cross-functional stakeholder leadership skills.
  • Ability to provide decisive direction while navigating technical uncertainty, incomplete information, and competing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in a relevant technical field.
  • Experience with advanced logic, DRAM, NAND, advanced packaging, and emerging semiconductor technologies.
  • Knowledge of specialty chemicals, precursor and etch chemistries, materials, contamination control, and semiconductor process integration.
  • Experience working directly with leading semiconductor manufacturers and equipment suppliers.

Why Work at Entegris

Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future.

Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort as we realize there are leaders at every level of the organization. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. We want the time and energy you spend here to have a positive impact on your life inside and outside of the office.


Entegris does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Entegris immigration sponsorship (e.g., H1B, TN, STEM OPT, etc.) now or in the future.

At Entegris we are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital or military status.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Manufacturing Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Senior Engineer, Manufacturing Engineering

Job Description:

THE ROLE:

We are seeking a Manufacturing Engineer – EUV to establish and strengthen manufacturing and engineering capability for the growing EUV business at the Munmak site in Korea, supporting the Advanced Purity Solutions Division.


This role will serve as a key technical and manufacturing leader for EUV products, supporting the full lifecycle from process development, qualification, and production readiness through productivity ramp-up, yield improvement, quality capability, OEE, capacity expansion, and continuous improvement.


As EUV represents an important new business and growth opportunity for the Munmak site and Korea market, this position will strengthen plant-level technical leadership, support customer engineering relationships, and build sustainable internal engineering capability for future business opportunities. You will work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, global engineering teams, and customer-facing organizations to translate product and customer requirements into robust manufacturing solutions.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead manufacturing engineering activities for EUV products from process development and qualification through production ramp-up and stable volume manufacturing.
  • Establish and optimize manufacturing processes, equipment, tooling, fixtures, process parameters, work instructions, and engineering standards required for EUV production.
  • Lead cross-functional execution of manufacturing readiness, qualification, productivity ramp-up, capacity expansion, quality improvement, and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Develop and execute process and manufacturing qualification plans in collaboration with Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other technical functions.
  • Establish and continuously improve manufacturing performance using key indicators including OEE, yield, first-pass yield (FPY), cycle time, productivity, scrap, capacity, process capability, and qualification status.
  • Apply statistical and engineering methods including SPC, Cp/Cpk, MSA, DOE, PFMEA, Control Plan, RCA, and structured problem-solving to understand process variation and establish sustainable process capability.
  • Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions for manufacturing, process, yield, and quality issues, ensuring improvements are technically validated, documented, and sustained.
  • Identify production bottlenecks and develop engineering solutions through process optimization, tooling improvement, automation, equipment upgrades, or capacity expansion.
  • Support manufacturing CAPEX planning by developing technical requirements, equipment specifications, capacity justification, supplier evaluations, FAT/SAT, installation, and equipment or process qualification.
  • Drive automation and digital manufacturing opportunities improve productivity, process consistency, traceability, data integrity, and operational visibility.
  • Provide manufacturing data, qualification evidence, process capability information, and technical analysis to support customer requirements and engineering discussions.
  • Translate customer requirements and technical expectations into actionable manufacturing and engineering requirements for the Munmak site.
  • Build effective technical relationships among customers, Munmak, and global engineering organizations to strengthen confidence in MMK manufacturing capability and plant leadership.
  • Evaluate manufacturing readiness for future EUV products and business opportunities and identify gaps in equipment, process technology, automation, metrology, quality capability, capacity, and engineering resources.
  • Develop scalable manufacturing solutions and internal technical capability that reduce dependency on external support and position MMK for future EUV growth opportunities in Korea.
  • Maintain required engineering documentation, change-control records, qualification evidence, technical reports, action logs, and other controlled records in accordance with applicable company processes.
  • Provide technical leadership across functions and drive assigned programs from requirement definition through implementation, validation, production release, and sustained performance.

What We Seek:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in mechanical, manufacturing, industrial, automation, mechatronics, materials engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in manufacturing engineering, process engineering, semiconductor manufacturing, high-purity manufacturing, precision manufacturing, automation, or another highly controlled manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead manufacturing or engineering projects across multiple functions.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, process qualification, production ramp-up, process control, capacity analysis, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience applying structured problem-solving and engineering methodologies such as RCA, 5 Whys, Fishbone, DOE, SPC, PFMEA, Control Plan, MSA, and process capability analysis.
  • Strong analytical capability with the ability to translate manufacturing and quality data into engineering decisions and improvement actions.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly with Manufacturing, Quality, Product Engineering, management, global technical teams, and customer-facing organizations.
  • Strong ownership and project leadership with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive cross-functional actions to completion.
  • Ability to work effectively in a global organization and communicate in English for technical discussions, engineering documentation, and cross-site collaboration.

Outstanding candidates will have:

  • Experience supporting semiconductor customers or semiconductor manufacturing environments.
  • Experience leading new product introduction (NPI), industrialization, process qualification, production transfer, requalification, or manufacturing ramp-up programs.
  • Experience interfacing directly with customers on technical requirements, qualification, manufacturing capability, or engineering issues.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering measurable improvements in OEE, yield, productivity, cycle time, capacity, process capability, or manufacturing quality.
  • Experience developing or implementing manufacturing automation, equipment integration, digital manufacturing, or production data and traceability solutions.
  • Experience preparing technical justification for CAPEX and leading equipment specification, supplier selection, FAT/SAT, and qualification.
  • Working knowledge of SAP, MES, SPC systems, electronic quality systems, or manufacturing data platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify capability gaps, develop manufacturing roadmaps, and build sustainable internal engineering capability.
  • Strong technical leadership capability with the potential to lead broader EUV manufacturing and engineering initiatives as the business expands.

Here at Entegris, we use advanced science to enable technologies that transform the world, and we are seeking employees who have the drive to continue that mission.

jobs.title: Liquid Systems Sustaining Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Liquid Systems Sustaining Engineering Manager

Job Description:

The Role: Sustaining Engineering Manager

Entegris is seeking an experienced and motivated Sustaining Engineering Manager to lead the global sustaining engineering organization supporting products within the Fluid Handling and Liquid Packaging Strategic Business Units (SBUs). This position may be located at either our Jangan, Korea or Munmak, Korea site and will be part of the Liquid Systems organization.


The manager will lead a team of global engineers responsible for sustaining engineering activities across manufacturing sites in Korea, and Taiwan. The team provides technical leadership for released products, drives product and process improvements, resolves field and manufacturing issues, supports quality and reliability initiatives, and helps ensure continuity of supply for Entegris' portfolio of high-purity fluid handling and liquid packaging products supporting the semiconductor industry.

This role requires a strong technical leader with demonstrated experience managing geographically dispersed engineering teams and leading cross-functional efforts involving Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, Product Management, and New Product Development organizations.

In this role you will:

Provide technical and organizational leadership for all global sustaining engineering activities related to released products within the Fluid Handling and Liquid Packaging SBUs. Establish priorities, develop technical talent, and drive consistent execution of sustaining engineering processes across global manufacturing locations. Serve as the primary engineering escalation point for product performance, reliability, quality, cost improvement, and continuity-of-supply initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a global team of sustaining engineers located across Korea, and Taiwan.
  • Own the technical support strategy for released products throughout their lifecycle.
  • Drive structured root cause investigations and corrective actions related to customer complaints, field failures, quality concerns, and manufacturing issues.
  • Partner with global manufacturing sites to improve product yield, quality, throughput, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Lead product improvement initiatives focused on performance, reliability, cost reduction, and manufacturability.
  • Support business continuity by identifying and mitigating product, process, supplier, and manufacturing risks.
  • Provide engineering leadership for product transfers, alternate-source qualifications, supplier changes, and manufacturing process improvements.
  • Lead engineering assessments related to product obsolescence, material changes, regulatory requirements, and end-of-life management.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Quality organizations to support customer engagements, technical problem resolution, and product stewardship activities.
  • Support manufacturing plants during audits, customer visits, qualification activities, and significant production challenges.
  • Ensure appropriate engineering support for change-control activities, including Engineering Change Requests (ECRs), Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), and Management of Change (MOC) processes.
  • Partner with New Product Development teams to incorporate lessons learned from manufacturing, customers, and field performance into future product designs.
  • Develop and manage sustaining engineering metrics, project portfolios, staffing plans, budgets, and resource priorities.
  • Drive standardization, knowledge sharing, and adoption of best practices across the global engineering organization.
  • Build and maintain a culture focused on safety, quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction.

Traits we believe make a strong candidate:

  • Proven technical and organizational leadership experience within a global engineering environment.
  • Demonstrated success leading sustaining engineering, product engineering, manufacturing engineering, or operations engineering teams.
  • Strong problem-solving and root cause investigation skills using structured methodologies.
  • Experience supporting released products through quality, reliability, manufacturing, and customer-facing challenges.
  • Ability to lead geographically distributed teams and influence stakeholders across functions and regions.
  • Strong background in product lifecycle management, change management, and sustaining engineering processes.
  • Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, quality systems, reliability engineering, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience supporting products used in highly controlled and quality-sensitive industries is preferred.
  • Experience with high-purity fluid handling, polymer components, semiconductor consumables, packaging, or related technologies is preferred.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, documentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while balancing immediate business needs with long-term strategic objectives.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to align technical decisions with organizational goals.
  • Demonstrated commitment to coaching, mentoring, and developing engineering talent.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of engineering experience supporting manufacturing, product development, product engineering, or sustaining engineering activities.
  • Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams.
  • Experience leading global or multi-site engineering organizations is preferred.
  • Strong English communication skills; Korean language proficiency is preferred.

Work Location and Travel

Position is based on-site in Korea at either the Jangan or Munmak facility.

Domestic and international travel is required to support manufacturing operations, customers, suppliers, and engineering teams in Korea, Taiwan, and the United States.

jobs.title: Manager, Analytics & Metrology
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Manager, Analytics & Metrology

Job Description:

POSITION SUMMARY

Entegris is seeking an Analytical Lab Operations Manager to oversee daily operations, strategic planning and technical projects of our Analytical Lab in Oseong, KR. In line with our PACE values, you will collaborate cross-functionally with technicians, scientists, engineers, leadership, sales, marketing and global technical teams to provide high quality, reliable data to the manufacturing team and other stakeholders.

What you’ll do:

  • Ensure lab has the proper resources and processes to report data accurately and timely to meet factory production schedules
  • Instill safety culture in team to meet goal of zero recordable injuries.
  • Recruit and hire new team members.
  • Provide feedback, mentor and develop team members to help them meet their career goals.
  • Provide training and training plans for team members.
  • Work with Quality team to ensure all quality best practices are being implemented. LTS, SPC charts and MSA requirements are tracked and completed on time.
  • Meet instrument uptime goals by ensuring we have the necessary trouble shooting skills, we provide timely maintenance, and PMs are completed on time.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Quality, Engineering, Operations, and R&D teams to support analytical requests and transition new products into production environment.
  • Provide technical support to CQE, MQE, Product Managers and other customer facing teams
  • Manage lab expenses to meet plant budgetary goals.
  • Develop processes to improve lab capacity, efficiency, and reduce waste
  • Support audits (internal and external) as needed.
  • Assist in Strategic Long-Range Planning to support factory 5-year roadmap.
  • This role is on-site in Oseong factory and supports 24x7 manufacturing facility.

What we seek:

  • Bachelor of Science in chemistry, physics or engineering or related field required, M.S. or Ph.D. preferred.
  • At least 5 years of relevant operational laboratory management experience as well as additional years of hands-on laboratory experience
  • Solid knowledge of analytical chemistry, materials science & physics required. Familiarity with semiconductor device materials, structures, and metrology preferred.
  • Working knowledge of lab instruments operations and analysis. (HPLC, IC, GC, ICP-MS, ICP-OES, FTIR, Raman, particle sizing instruments)
  • Ability to create and manage project plans and timelines, define project deliverables, assign project team roles and resources, identify and track issues and their resolution, and manage project scope, creep, and requirements.
  • Familiarity with Good Lab Practices and Good Manufacturing Practices
  • Proficient in data analysis, statistical methods, and quality management systems.
  • Knowledge of proper controls for analytical instrumentation, SPC, stability, accuracy, variation, and method uncertainty and GR&R required.
  • Understands customer quality requirements and expectations and works to meet those goals.
  • Hands on experience with applicable quality tools such as pareto, FMEA’s, SPC/SQC, histograms, trend analysis, process mapping, design of experiments, cause and effect diagrams, 8D problem solving methodology required.
  • Ability to wear the required PPE when working in the labs (safety glasses, face shields, lab coat, steel toe boots, cleanroom garments etc.)
  • Prior experience managing people and working w/ global teams

Job Title:

Senior Engineer, Control Systems Engineering

Job Description:

The Role:

Our JangAn, Korea facility is seeking a Senior Engineer, Control Systems Engineering to provide technical leadership for advanced automation systems supporting global manufacturing operations. This SME role drives the design, implementation, and optimization of OT hardware, instrumentation, control networks, and cybersecurity solutions while advancing process technology, automation standards, and strategic initiatives across global sites.

As a semiconductor manufacturer, we maintain rigorous quality and process control standards, and this role is instrumental in advancing them through process optimization and innovative automation technologies. The position also provides opportunities to develop expertise in Rockwell Automation, Ignition, MES platforms (Critical Manufacturing), statistical process control, and automated process data collection and analytics.

What You’ll Do:

  • Drive a Safety First culture by conducting behavioral and safety assessments and implementing equipment, automation, and process improvements to mitigate risk.

  • Lead & Support projects to expand manufacturing capacity, transition products to high volume manufacturing, New Product Introductions and continuous improvement opportunities for existing processes and manufacturing sites.

jobs.title: Lead Scientist, CMP/pCMP
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Lead Scientist, CMP/pCMP

Job Description:

The Role:

  • Entegris is seeking a Lead Scientist with deep chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) and post-CMP cleaning (pCMP) experience to lead the development of advanced slurry and cleaning solutions for semiconductor applications.

  • In this role, you will apply broad technical expertise and in-depth knowledge of CMP and pCMP mechanisms to solve complex customer and product-development challenges. You will lead critical technical workstreams, define experimental strategies, and translate structure-performance relationships into differentiated products and process solutions.

  • The Lead Scientist will work across global R&D, Applications, Analytical, Manufacturing, Quality, Product Management, Marketing, and customer-facing teams. This position is an experienced technical leadership role and does not require direct people-management responsibility.

In this role you will:

  • Technical Innovation & Product Development

    • Lead the formulation and process development of CMP slurries and pCMP cleaning chemistries for advanced semiconductor applications.
    • Define technical strategy, test plans, decision criteria, and development pathways for complex projects with significant technical ambiguity.
    • Establish structure-property-performance relationships involving abrasive particles, oxidizers, inhibitors, complexing agents, polymers, surfactants, dispersants, and cleaning additives.
    • Develop mechanistic understanding of material removal, selectivity, defectivity, corrosion, residue removal, particle contamination, surface condition, and formulation stability.
    • Design and direct statistically robust experiments, including DOE and multivariate analysis, and integrate wafer, coupon, analytical, and formulation data to guide development decisions.
    • Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex slurry, cleaning, process, equipment, scale-up, and customer-performance issues.

  • Product Commercialization & Customer Success

    • Partner with Applications teams to design and execute CMP and pCMP evaluations on relevant films, substrates, test wafers, and patterned wafers.
    • Translate customer requirements and device/process trends into product specifications, technical milestones, and differentiated value propositions.
    • Lead technical reviews and communicate conclusions, risks, and recommendations to senior R&D leaders, cross-functional stakeholders, and customers.
    • Support raw-material selection, formulation robustness, scale-up, technology transfer, product qualification, and New Product Introduction.
    • Drive intellectual property creation through invention disclosures, patent support, technical documentation, and protection of proprietary know-how.

  • Technical Leadership & Operational Excellence

    • Provide technical mentorship to scientists, engineers, and technicians and help establish best practices for experimental rigor, data quality, and laboratory execution.
    • Build productive global networks and influence technical direction across teams without relying on direct authority.
    • Maintain exemplary EHS, chemical-handling, quality, and documentation practices and actively strengthen a safety-first culture.
    • Travel up to 30%, including customer sites and global technology or manufacturing locations, based on business needs.

Traits we believe make a strong candidate:

  • Ph.D. in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science, Surface Science, or a related field with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience; OR a Master’s degree with a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience; OR a Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; equivalent education and experience may be considered.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in CMP slurry development, pCMP cleaning development, CMP process development, or closely related semiconductor surface-processing technology.

  • Deep understanding of CMP and pCMP fundamentals, including surface chemistry, colloid and interface science, particle behavior, chemical-mechanical interactions, corrosion control, residue removal, and defect mechanisms.

  • Proven ability to independently solve complex, multi-variable technical problems and to determine appropriate methods, experiments, and decision criteria.

  • Strong record of designing and analyzing statistically rigorous experiments and converting complex datasets into clear technical conclusions and next steps.

  • Experience connecting formulation composition and process conditions to removal rate, selectivity, defects, surface quality, cleaning efficiency, and product robustness.

  • Experience with semiconductor materials such as metals, dielectrics, barrier or liner films, and advanced interconnect materials is preferred.

  • Experience supporting customer engagements, product qualification, scale-up, technology transfer, or commercialization is strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated technical leadership, influence, mentoring capability, and effective collaboration across global and cross-functional organizations.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technically complex information in English to global teams and customers.

  • Strong commitment to laboratory safety, data integrity, intellectual property protection, and disciplined technical documentation.

Your success will be measured by:

  • Technical leadership: Establishes credible technical direction and resolves high-impact CMP and pCMP challenges through sound scientific judgment.

  • Innovation and differentiation: Creates protectable formulations, mechanisms, methods, or product concepts that deliver meaningful customer value.

  • Project impact: Delivers critical technical milestones, manages uncertainty and risk, and enables timely project decisions.

  • Customer relevance: Connects customer process requirements to practical, robust, and differentiated material solutions.

  • Collaboration and influence: Builds effective global partnerships and aligns cross-functional teams around evidence-based recommendations.

  • Talent development: Raises team capability through mentoring, technical reviews, knowledge sharing, and rigorous experimental standards.

  • Safety and quality: Demonstrates visible leadership in EHS, data integrity, documentation, and product-development discipline.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Analytical R&D
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Senior Scientist, Analytical R&D

Job Description:

The Role

Entegris is seeking a Senior Analytical Scientist to join our Analytical R&D team at our Ansan Korea Technology Center (KTC) facility.

In this role, you will lead the development, validation, and continuous improvement of analytical methods used to characterize complex materials, mixtures, and formulations. You will apply advanced analytical chemistry, metrology, and statistical techniques to support new product development, improve existing products, resolve challenging technical problems, and respond to internal and external customer needs. You will work closely with global R&D, engineering, manufacturing, quality, sales, marketing, and external laboratory partners.

What You’ll Do

  • Support the development, optimization, validation, and transfer of analytical methods for complex analyses.

  • Design and execute analytical experiments, interpret data, draw technically sound conclusions, and communicate results through reports, presentations, and discussions with technical teams and customers.

  • Establish and document method performance characteristics, including detection limits, accuracy, precision, stability, robustness, and measurement-system capability.

  • Collaborate with product-development teams to define analytical requirements for new materials, formulations, and products.

  • Evaluate, qualify, maintain, and troubleshoot analytical instrumentation such as ICP-MS, ICP-OES, ion chromatography, HPLC, and FTIR.

  • Support analytical method change-impact assessments and contribute to cross-functional safety, readiness, and change-control reviews.

  • Prepare and maintain SOPs, work instructions, technical reports, method validation documentation, measurement-system analyses, and verification or qualification records.

  • Provide technical guidance and training to laboratory colleagues on analytical instrumentation, methods, data interpretation, documentation, and safe laboratory practices.

  • Support global analytical-development programs and collaborate effectively with R&D teams, manufacturing engineers, quality partners, and external laboratories.

  • Promote a strong safety culture and maintain audit-ready laboratory practices while handling chemicals and performing work in laboratory and cleanroom environments.

What We Seek

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a closely related scientific discipline.

  • At least three years of relevant experience in an analytical, R&D, product-development, or comparable laboratory environment.

  • Demonstrated experience developing, validating, or improving analytical methods for complex materials, mixtures, formulations, or high-purity products.

  • Working knowledge of one or more relevant analytical techniques, such as ICP-MS, ICP-OES, ion chromatography, HPLC, or FTIR.

  • Ability to design experiments, analyze technical data, evaluate method performance, and translate findings into clear conclusions and recommendations.

  • Understanding of measurement-system analysis, method capability, statistical analysis, root-cause investigation, and corrective-action principles.

  • Experience preparing controlled technical documentation, including SOPs, work instructions, validation protocols, qualification records, and reports.

  • Ability to work safely with hazardous materials and follow applicable laboratory, cleanroom, chemical-handling, and personal-protective-equipment requirements.

  • Strong project-management, prioritization, and problem-solving skills, with the flexibility to manage multiple assignments and respond to changing business needs.

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including professional proficiency in English.
