Job Title:

Specialist, Global R&D Sampling & Logistics Coordinator

Job Description:

Global R&D Sampling & Logistics Coordinator (L2)

The Global R&D Sampling & Logistics Coordinator enables faster innovation and on-time, high-quality NPI delivery by managing the compliant movement of materials, components, and customer samples across a global network of sites and regions. This role plays a critical part in “shifting left” key readiness and compliance activities, such as SDS country and language requirements and material and site readiness, ensuring that issues are identified and resolved early rather than at the point of shipment. By proactively identifying risks and coordinating cross-functional execution, this role enables R&D teams to focus on innovation while ensuring products are delivered to customers with speed, quality, and reliability.

Key Responsibilities:

Drive NPI Sampling Execution (Speed & Proactivity) and Continuous Improvement

  • Coordinate end-to-end R&D shipments, receivals, and sample requests, proactively identifying and resolving risks early to ensure on-time material staging, component availability, and customer sample delivery while minimizing delays.

  • Identify bottlenecks and support improvements to reduce turnaround time, improve data quality, and standardize processes.

  • Identify root causes of delays or execution issues (e.g., missing data, process gaps, system limitations) and take ownership to drive resolution, leveraging cross-functional partners to remove roadblocks and prevent recurrence.

Execute Customer Sample Shipments (Quality & Reliability)

  • Ensure shipments are accurate, compliant, and right-first time, including proper documentation, packaging, and traceability.

  • Facilitate compliance workflows as needed to ensure the complete and correct documentation is aligned to origin and destination requirements.

Operate Across a Global, Cross-functional Environment

  • Manage shipments across multiple regions and time zones, addressing regional requirements and coordinating local and non-local sampling scenarios.

  • Serve as the central point of coordination across R&D, TPM, Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Trade Compliance, EHS, and Quality, ensuring clear ownership and efficient handoffs.

Manage Global RM Movement

  • Coordinate internal transfers of materials and components across global sites, ensuring material, site readiness, and documentation requirements are met to enable seamless execution.

  • Work closely with R&D, TPM, MQE and commodity managers to proactively obtain or stage materials and components at global sites, and evaluate RM options based on supplier, quality, availability, and location.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in engineering, chemistry, or a related field.

  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple requests simultaneously.

  • High attention to detail, particularly in documentation and compliance-driven processes.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work effectively across multiple teams and functions.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with global teams across regions and time zones.

  • Experience supporting R&D, customer sampling, or NPI-related workflows.

  • Demonstrated interest in process improvement and proactive problem-solving.

  • Familiarity with ERP or logistics systems (e.g., SAP).

  • Exposure to trade compliance concepts (e.g., ECCN, HTS, export/import documentation, SDS).

Success Measures (What Good Looks Like):

  • Sampling and internal material and component movements are executed quickly, with reduced turnaround time and minimal delays.

  • Risks and gaps are identified early and addressed before impacting customer deliveries—no “last-minute” issues.

  • Shipments are executed with complete and accurate documentation, reducing rework and compliance risk.

  • Cross-region shipments and coordination are handled smoothly with minimal friction or rework.

  • Teams are aligned, roles are clear, and handoffs between functions are efficient.

  • R&D teams spend less time on coordination and issue resolution, allowing increased focus on developing and delivering innovative solutions.

에어리퀴드는 주요 산업(석유화학, 정유, 철강, 자동차, 신재생에너지 등)에 산업용 가스 및 관련 서비스를 제공하여 성장에 기여하고 환경 친화적인 요구를 충족시켜 왔습니다. 또한 수소에너지 등을 통해 미래 친환경 에너지 사업의 기반을 다지기 위해 노력하고 있습니다.

The primary focus of the Engineering department is to lead and execute large and mid sized capital projects and smaller continuous improvement projects related to commercial chemical manufacturing processes. The Senior Mechanical / Process Equipment Engineer provides subject matter expertise in the areas of mechanical design and mechanical integrity to ALAM. The primary activities of the department are:
1. Create three-dimensional design packages based upon process specification documents received from the Process Engineering and other groups. Designs should meet or exceed requirements for safety, quality, cost-effectiveness, constructability, maintainability, and mechanical integrity.
2. Improvement activities related to commercial chemical manufacturing processes.
3. Provide technical solutions and insights, leadership, and assistance in implementation.
Key collaborators in these activities are Process Development, Process Engineering, Automation and Controls, Production, Quality, and Safety departments. Key customers are ESSH, Quality, and Production.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

  • Work as part of a cross-functional team to develop, design, specify, and commission production equipment for the next generation of materials required for the microelectronics and solar manufacturers.
  • Design standard process equipment solutions that apply across product lines.
  • Develop practical solutions to complex technical problems, with systematic traceable design methodology.
  • Direct projects to on time, on budget delivery with required safety and quality.
  • Provide mechanical and process equipment engineering expertise across various product lines and sites.
  • Troubleshoot process equipment and systems.
  • Identify and implement methods for manufacturing cost reduction in line with business needs.
  • Improve the safety of existing manufacturing installations.
  • Document and communicate institutional knowledge throughout the organization.
  • Make quantitative, fact-based decisions.
  • Participate in the training of Maintenance and Production personnel.
  • 15%~20% domestic and international travel for commissioning and support

Are you a MATCH?


  • BS or MS in Mechanical or Chemical Engineering with a strong mechanical aptitude.
  • 12+ years of mechanical design experience, directly applicable to the design of chemical process equipment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Korean and English.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of mechanical design and engineering fundamentals.
  • Solid EPC experience in one or more phases of major capital projects, such as proposals, FEED, detail engineering, field engineering, and/or commissioning support.
  • Experience in pressure piping/tubing engineering and coordination.
  • Experience in plant layout engineering and coordination.
  • Experience with engineering tools, including 2D AutoCAD.
  • Formal process safety experience is a plus, especially in Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) leadership, LOPA, and HAZOP.
  • Demonstrated ability and drive to develop safe, reliable solutions.
  • Demonstrated logical problem-solving aptitude.
  • Proven track record of delivering on commitments.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Solution/outcome-oriented with the ability to work independently under minimal supervision.
  • Proven ability to lead change, personally adaptable, and able to perform well under pressure and continuously changing priorities.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and remain open to feedback through cooperative, respectful, and fact-based interactions.




Recruitment Process

jobs.title: Engineering & Construction Project Engineer
jobs.description:

Air Liquide Engineering & Technologies brings together Air Liquide’s expertise in technology, engineering, construction, manufacturing, project development and execution, to design and deliver cutting-edge industrial solutions for the Air Liquide Group and external customers.

With a unique portfolio of technologies, we offer a wide range of solutions to accompany the growth and meet the evolving needs of our customers, from the design of industrial gas production units to the manufacture of cryogenic equipment for space and energy applications, as well as low-carbon technologies such as electrolyzers and CO₂ capture solutions or technologies for the semiconductor industry.

Base Location: Gasan Engineering Office, Seoul, South Korea



  • Project & Schedule Control: Own overall engineering progress, manage schedule deviations, lead design review meetings, and log technical lessons learned

jobs.title: E&I Engineer
jobs.description:
에어리퀴드는 주요 산업(석유화학, 정유, 철강, 자동차, 신재생에너지 등)에 산업용 가스 및 관련 서비스를 제공하여 성장에 기여하고 환경 친화적인 요구를 충족시켜 왔습니다. 또한 수소에너지 등을 통해 미래 친환경 에너지 사업의 기반을 다지기 위해 노력하고 있습니다.

에어리퀴드코리아는 고체 프리커서(Solid Precursor) 및 특수가스 공급 장치 분야의 전 세계 1위 기술력을 바탕으로 글로벌 Top-tier 반도체 고객사에 통합 가스 공급 솔루션을 제공하고 있습니다.
그룹의 새로운 중장기 전략인 'BEYOND' 체제하에서, 당사는 'Listen & Care(고객의 목소리에 귀 기울이고 차별화된 가치 전달)'를 최우선 가치로 삼고 AI 및 반도체 시장에서의 지배력을 강화하고 있습니다.
본 포지션은 그룹의 BEYOND 비전을 현장에서 실현하는 핵심 소통 창구입니다.
단순한 장비 공급이나 단편적인 엔지니어링 접근을 넘어, 엔지니어링 전문성을 바탕으로 고객의 기술적·운영적 니즈를 깊이 있게 경청하고 이를 최적의 비즈니스/상업적 솔루션으로 치환하여 제안합니다.
프랑스(ALES), 미국(ALAM), 일본(ALJ) 등 해외 계열사 및 내부 Equipment & Installation 팀과의 긴밀한 협업을 바탕으로, 수주부터 납기 관리, 기술 이슈 해결까지 전 과정을 주도하여 지속 가능한 고객 신뢰와 비즈니스 성장을 이끌어냅니다.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

1) 고객 계정 관리 및 영업 활동

- 영업 기회 발굴 및 제안: 반도체/디스플레이 고객사의 신규 라인 투자 및 장비 교체 수요를 선제적으로 파악하여 자사 가스공급장치 및 솔루션 소개 및 수주 활동 주도

- 고객 중심의 기술 소통: 기술적 사양이나 문제 발생 시, 엔지니어링 전문성 기반의 고객 맞춤형 커뮤니케이션으로 높은 신뢰와 만족도 구축

- 견적 및 상업 조건 협상: 장비 P&L 및 원가 구조를 바탕으로 상업적 타당성 검토, 경쟁력 있는 견적 작성 및 계약 조건 협상 주도


2) 납기 관리 및 프로젝트 진행 모니터링

- 납기 관리 : 에어리퀴드 글로벌 제조 계열사(ALES/ALJ 등) 및 OEM 파트너사와 생산 일정을 수시로 점검 및 고객이 요청한 납기내에 장비가 차질 없이 공급되도록 전 과정 리드

- SCM 및 물류 조율: 계약 체결부터 장비 입고, 통관 및 현장 배송까지의 프로세스를 관리하여 딜레이 요인 미연 방지


3) 기술 이슈 대응 및 문제 해결 총괄

- 1차 기술 싱크 및 이슈 뷰어: 고객 현장에서 제기되는 기술적 문의, 사양 변경 요청, 트러블슈팅 건에 대해 1차적으로 의도 파악 및 경중 판별

- 내부 엔지니어링 팀과의 협업: 복잡한 기술 이슈를 유관 부서 및 글로벌 전문가와 신속히 조율하고, 내부 기술 답변을 고객 맞춤형 해결책으로 재구성하여 전달


4) 현장(Fab) 대응 및 사후 관리

- 적절한 현장 밀착 대응 (Fab 근무 비중 약 30% 이내): 필요 시 고객사 Fab 입선, 셋업/인수 평가(Qualification) 단계의 주요 미팅 및 현장 점검 참관 및 고객 요청사항에 즉각 대응

- 고객 불만 관리 및 CS 개선: 기술 위주의 단편적 답변으로 발생할 수 있는 고객 불만을 방지하고, 고객 감성과 비즈니스 관계를 고려한 항구적 개선 대책 및 사후 서비스 제공

Since 1962, Air Liquide Advanced Technologies affiliates are recognized for their leading expertise in gas processing (gas treatment, separation, refrigeration, liquefaction, analysis and control, storage and distribution), serving various high technology markets: space, aeronautics, marine, large scientific instruments, electronics, energy transition, ...
Air Liquide Advanced Technologies Korea is responsible for the design and the production of clean energy solutions. The development of hydrogen and of biomethane as clean energy carriers are identified as promising emerging markets for the Group, with a focus on energy and mobility applications through fuel cell electric vehicles (passenger cars, material handling vehicles, public transportation, heavy transport).
Located in Seoul (Korea), New Energies design, produce and sell New Energy projects and provide related services in Korea to external customers, as well as for the projects of which AL is a shareholder. Korea is one of the key pioneering countries for the deployment of those technologies and Air Liquide New Energies Korea is currently executing Projects of HRS for passenger cars, buses and trucks and plans to further expand for the design and construction of HRS projects. Contract values are typically upto 6 million EUR per project, requiring lean and agile project execution capabilities.

As a Electrical and Control Systems Engineer, you will be involved in Product development phase until the completion of execution of the detailed design, construction and commissioning of the new HRS Projects. You will also support commissioning team during the commissioning and startup phase of the project, as well as troubleshooting during normal operation of the HRS. You will be in charge of the Project Electrical and Control Systems technical studies and design development in liaison with the different internal and external stakeholders. You will ensure that the project technical documentation is controlled in terms of planning and quality, and the compliance of the delivered product with the technical specifications and local regulation in close coordination with the Engineering Manager and the Design Authorities. You will support the existing HRS After Sales services for Maintenance and Trouble Shooting during operations.

Support Engineering team / Engineering Director for the specification validation in the development of safe and reliable HRS products.

- Communication with the Group technical organization (in Korea and overseas)

- Communication with local suppliers for the development of technical solutions and for obtaining budgetary quotations

- Support in Preparation of technical deliverables for HRS projects Proposals

- Support in Preparation of cost estimation

2. Project Execution Phase:

Support the Project Manager / Commissioning Manager / Engineering Manager for the delivery of safe and reliable Hydrogen related plant in accordance with the Product specifications and contractual requirements:

- Prepare, maintain and control the project technical documentation deliverable list

- Prepare and update the Engineering Drawings such as SLD, Instrumentation list, I/O lists, Instrument specification, Control Systems Specifications

- Participate to design reviews with internal and external stakeholders

- Follow-up of the implementation of the Design Reviews conclusions / actions

- Prepare RFQ technical specification for Electrical and Control Systems equipment purchase

- Support in the RFQ technical specification preparation for Mechanical and Electrical installation contract

- Technical clarification with Vendors/Subcontractors and technical bid evaluation

- Follow-up of Vendor's design documentation submission and internal reviews

- Follow-up of Vendor's manufacturing progress

- Participate to Final Inspection / Factory Acceptance Tests of Mechanical / Packaged equipment

- Perform the FAT of Electrical and Control Systems

- Support in the preparation of design dossier required for permitting activities and application to relevant authorities

- Participate in the development of pre-commissioning / commissioning procedures, operations manual

- Ensure that the design modifications are controlled and properly communicated to the stakeholders

- Support the Project Execution Team for the administration of Vendor's POs and Customer contracts

- Support the Project Execution Team during construction and commissioning activities

- Perform the SAT of the Electrical and Control Systems

3. Post-project phase

- Participates to the Project capitalization process (lessons learnt) aiming to continuously improve Products and services

- Support commissioning and maintenance Team for the follow-up and technical resolution of trouble-shooting and upgrades

1. Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical, Electronic, or Automation Engineering
2. +5 years experience in PLC/ Gas / Chemical Engineering industry or Electricity industries
3. Engineer Electricity (전기기사) is a plus. Knows Simense PLC

jobs.title: ERP Project Manager
jobs.description:
How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

This role is central to the post-merger integration (PMI) of Air Liquide Korea (ALK) and DIG Airgas (DIG). Serving as the vital bridge between local executive leadership, site teams, the central PMO, and technical build teams, you will ensure the ALign Regional Core model is adopted without deviation while seamlessly managing local data, site readiness, training, and cutover execution.

Key Responsibilities & Scope of Work

1. Governance, Alignment & Scope Control

  • Local Site Mobilization: Drive local site mobilization, onboard country champions and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and track local progress against master implementation milestones.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the primary bridge aligning local country executive leadership, plant leads, legacy DIG functional counterparts, and central/regional technical build teams.
  • RAID & Risk Escalation: Maintain the local RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) log; escalate critical-path blockers to the central PMO and enforce strict scope governance (preventing unapproved local scope additions).

2. Pre-Go-Live Execution & Site Readiness

  • SME & Resource Coordination: Coordinate local SME availability and secure operational commitment across all business tracks (Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Plan-to-Produce, Asset Management, Record-to-Report).
  • Site & Technical Readiness: Ensure local site infrastructure, operational hardware (handheld scanners, industrial label printers), network bandwidth, and server/Azure configurations meet ALign deployment standards.
  • Data Migration & Mock Drops: Oversee local data cleansing, enrichment, taxonomy harmonization, and data extraction/migration milestones across scheduled mock drops.
  • Training & Change Management: Support training activities in coordination with the central core team (defining scenarios, coordinating participants, and overseeing schedule completion).
  • Change Impact Assessment: Support change management actions and lead local change impact assessments across diverse plant, sales, and logistics locations.
  • Readiness Sign-Off: Rigorously validate and assure comprehensive site readiness before Go-Live authorization.

3. Cutover & Post-Go-Live Stabilization (Hypercare)

  • Cutover Orchestration: Direct cutover dress rehearsals and manage local Go-Live cutover command center activities to ensure zero disruption to industrial gas delivery and operations.
  • 2-Month Hypercare Management: Lead the 2-month post-go-live Hypercare phase, monitoring site operational KPIs, resolving local incidents, and triggering Business Continuity Plans (BCPs) where required.
  • Legacy ERP Decommissioning: Oversee the formal data archiving, validation audits, and technical decommissioning of legacy ALK and legacy DIG ERP instances.

___________________

Are you a MATCH?

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.
  • Direct Experience: 7–12 years in enterprise IT/business transformation, with proven experience in enterprise ERP rollouts (Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O, SAP, or Oracle) as a Project Manager, Deployment Lead, or Functional Cutover Lead.
  • M&A / Convergence Track Record: Demonstrated experience merging or consolidating disparate legacy systems into a unified platform within an IMO or post-merger integration (PMI) context.
  • Industry Domain: Background in manufacturing, process industries, industrial gas/chemicals, or asset-intensive logistics (cylinder and bulk distribution models) is preferred.

Core Competencies & Skills

  • Operational Coordination: Outstanding ability to organize cross-functional workstreams, track action items, and maintain schedule momentum under tight project deadlines.
  • Assertive Stakeholder Management: Comfort and diplomatic firmness in liaising with local team leads and plant managers; capability to challenge legacy habits and defend core model integrity.
  • Project Delivery Rigor: Deep understanding of hybrid/agile implementation frameworks (Waterfall cutover, Agile sprints, Sure Step). Experience utilizing RAID logs and PMO tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, SmartSheet).
  • Communication & Languages: Business fluency in both Korean (for daily local stakeholder, plant, and logistics engagement) and English (for active collaboration with regional/global ALign Core teams).

1) In alignment with the Group's Industrial Direction (GID) Assets & Technology Experts team, develop and update Group standards related to Bulk industrial assets and technology. For reference, bulk assets include (but are not limited) vacuum insulated cryogenic storage tanks, high pressure hydrogen vessels, vaporizers and trailers.
2) Ensure compliance with Group's standards related to Bulk industrial assets and technology, by periodically auditing our installations, composing action plans from the audits, and following up on the closure of the resulting actions.
3) Ensure safety, operational efficiency, maintainability and cost competitiveness of the East Asia Pacific (EAP) Cluster's bulk industrial assets (Fixed or mobile). The East Asia Paific Cluster is comprised of twelve countries in the region.
4) Drive the selected programs and initiatives across East Asia Pacific countries.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

  • Partner with Group Industrial Direction experts to guide entities on Bulk industrial asset choices (fixed/mobile), ensuring safety, compliance, operability, and cost competitiveness.
  • Simplify and streamline Bulk Asset (tanks and trailers) specifications in collaboration with Procurement to lower total cost of ownership and optimize Capex requests.
  • Lead supply chain asset lifecycle management, resource sizing, and standard operating model deployment across the Cluster's countries.
  • Utilize standardized tools to recalculate and optimize tank capacity sizing for new and existing customer supply chain setups.
  • Steer the Road Safety program across the cluster, collaborate with safety communities, update training curricula, and support IMS audits.
  • Develop and implement localized maintenance regimes and strategies in coordination with country teams to preserve asset health throughout its lifecycle.
  • Act as Data Owner for bulk asset master data, building and maintaining high-quality, dynamic databases.
  • Lead industrial expert communities and workgroups (e.g., AIGA CES) to drive industry watch tasks, knowledge sharing, and regulatory alignment.

Are you a MATCH?

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Chemical or Supply Chain related discipline.
  • Relevant professional experience in Safety Management or Gas Installation Engineering.
  • Proven background in Asset Management and technical design validation.
  • Remuneration will be aligned with the local compensation package of the candidate's respective country.

**We thank you for your interest in Air Liquide. Interested applicants are encouraged to send in a detailed resume, including reasons for leaving for past employment. Please be informed that only shortlisted candidates would be notified.**

A world leader in gases, technologies and services for Industry and Health, Air Liquide is present in 78 countries with approximately 64,500 employees and serves more than 3.8 million customers and patients. jobs.title: Head of Procurement, Korea
jobs.description:

As a member of the Country/Cluster Management Committee, the Head of Procurement is responsible for the Procurement Performance of the overall country scope:
- He/she leads all Sourcing Management activities for the geography and is accountable for the overall performance of the procurement teams
- He/she supports and promotes decisions taken by APAC HUB Category Managers in his/her geography, and provide necessary insights to influence centralised/central-led strategy
- He/she holds a pivotal role between APAC HUB procurement central team, Country/Cluster business leaders & local procurement teams, integrating various inputs & perspectives to build a common vision leading to aligned execution

As a member of the APAC Procurement Organization, he/she contributes to its global mission:

- Hold a firm 'no compromise' stand on safety and ethics, in all procurement practices throughout the organization

jobs.description:

Air Liquide Engineering & Technologies brings together Air Liquide’s expertise in technology, engineering, construction, manufacturing, project development and execution, to design and deliver cutting-edge industrial solutions for the Air Liquide Group and external customers.

With a unique portfolio of technologies, we offer a wide range of solutions to accompany the growth and meet the evolving needs of our customers, from the design of industrial gas production units to the manufacture of cryogenic equipment for space and energy applications, as well as low-carbon technologies such as electrolyzers and CO₂ capture solutions or technologies for the semiconductor industry.

We are currently seeking two Project Directors to lead industrial EPC projects across the APAC region, with immediate focus on driving construction projects in South Korea.

Location: Air Liquide Gasan Engineering Office, Seoul (with regional APAC travel)
Reporting To: COO, E&C China
Contract type: Permanent

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

As Project Director, your role will be to oversee the full lifecycle of EPC projects across three phases:


1. Project Development & Bidding Phase

  • Collaborate with business development and proposal teams to build competitive execution and sourcing plans
  • Review project scopes, site requirements, resource availability, cost estimates, and risk mitigation strategies
  • Verify that technical and commercial proposals align with contract requirements and company standards

2. Project Execution Phase

  • Take full ownership of EPC project delivery, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to required specifications
  • Manage vendors, contractors, and internal teams to optimize cost, quality, and scheduling
  • Lead site construction and pre-commissioning work to guarantee operational readiness
  • Coordinate interactions between internal stakeholders, partners, and client representatives to meet the performance up to the transfer to Operations
  • Manage scope changes, permits, and ongoing project risks
  • Oversee final testing, secure the Preliminary Acceptance Certificate, and smoothly hand over the facility to the Operations team

3. Safety & Continuous Improvement

  • Align the execution plan and team assignments with all Safety, Quality, Risk Management, and Integrated Management System (IMS) requirements.
  • Continuously enforce Safety, Quality, and Risk processes throughout the entire project execution.
  • Prepare and conduct the capitalization review

  • Proven ability to manage end-to-end industrial EPC projects
  • Strong leadership skills with a track record of managing project teams and influencing stakeholders
  • Adaptability in dynamic environments
  • Willingness to travel regularly across the APAC region

산업용 가스 및 홈헬스케어 가스, 관련 기술 및 서비스 분야의 세계적인 리더인 에어리퀴드는 78개국에 약 64,500명의 직원이 근무하고 있으며 380만 명 이상의 고객과 환자에게 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다. 산소, 질소 및 수소는 생명, 물질 및 에너지에 필수적인 작은 분자입니다.

우리는 배경에 관계 없이 지원 자격을 갖춘 모든 지원자의 입사 지원을 환영합니다.
에어리퀴드는 다양성을 갖춘 조직이 개인적 집단적으로 사람들이 자신의 재능을 표현할 수 있는 기회를 열어주며, 기본 원칙에 따라 생활하고, 성공을 위해 행동하며, 변화하는 세상에서 참여적인 환경을 조성함으로써 혁신 능력을 키우는 데 도움이 된다고 굳게 믿습니다.

산업용 가스 및 홈헬스케어 가스, 관련 기술 및 서비스 분야의 세계적인 리더인 에어리퀴드는 78개국에 약 64,500명의 직원이 근무하고 있으며 380만 명 이상의 고객과 환자에게 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다. 산소, 질소 및 수소는 생명, 물질 및 에너지에 필수적인 작은 분자입니다.
이는 에어리퀴드의 과학적 영역을 구현하며 1902년 창립 이래로 핵심적인 비즈니스 분야입니다.

Our Differences make our Performance

에어리퀴드는 우리의 직원, 고객, 환자, 지역사회 관계자 및 전 세계 문화의 다양성을 포용하는 다양하고 포용적인 근무 환경을 구축하기 위해 최선을 다하고 있습니다.
우리는 배경에 관계 없이 지원 자격을 갖춘 모든 지원자의 입사 지원을 환영합니다.
에어리퀴드는 다양성을 갖춘 조직이 개인적 집단적으로 사람들이 자신의 재능을 표현할 수 있는 기회를 열어주며, 기본 원칙에 따라 생활하고, 성공을 위해 행동하며, 변화하는 세상에서 참여적인 환경을 조성함으로써 혁신 능력을 키우는 데 도움이 된다고 굳게 믿습니다.

jobs.title: Senior Global Planner
jobs.description:
에어리퀴드는 주요 산업(석유화학, 정유, 철강, 자동차, 신재생에너지 등)에 산업용 가스 및 관련 서비스를 제공하여 성장에 기여하고 환경 친화적인 요구를 충족시켜 왔습니다. 또한 수소에너지 등을 통해 미래 친환경 에너지 사업의 기반을 다지기 위해 노력하고 있습니다.

Global Planner will play a critical role in strategic resource allocation, optimization and capacity planning within our organization. You will be responsible for developing, implementing and managing global supply planning strategies to optimize the utilization of resources, meet customer demand, and support the achievement of business objectives. Your expertise in supply chain management, demand forecasting, and capacity planning will be essential in coordinating and aligning planning activities across multiple locations and timeframes.
Global Planners will be assigned by product segment and be responsible for identification and clear articulation of global demand, supply, capacity and inventory requirements, constraints, mitigation & optimization plans defined and confirmed through the S&OP process.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

  • Develop, execute & manage global supply planning strategies by product category, with the objective of optimizing supply chain costs, capital and reliability considering factors such as customer demand, production capacity, inventory levels, lead times, mobile asset requirements & qualified customer supply lines
  • Lead, guide & collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, operations, procurement, logistics and ALAM distribution channels, to gather demand forecasts, production plans, inventory data to support the global planning process and successfully execute supply planning strategies.
  • Conduct analysis and evaluation of demand patterns, market trends, and supply chain constraints to ensure accurate and robust global supply chain reliability.
  • Define, calculate, justify and maintain global planning parameters, such as required service factors, safety stock levels (DOI), reorder points, and lead times, based on business requirements and optimization models.
  • Manage & facilitate formalized demand planning meetings with ALAM distribution channels and provide financial analysis and justifications to support working capital requirements to ensure supply chain reliability.
  • Coordinate with ALAM affiliates, Finite Planners and other stakeholders to align inventory, capacity and resource utilization across different locations, ensuring optimal production and distribution strategies.
  • Define, monitor, analyze and optimize key performance indicators (KPIs), such as forecast accuracy, inventory turns, service levels and production efficiency, to identify areas for improvement, develop action plans and lead/manage implementation of supply optimization initiatives.
  • Collaborate with technology teams to identify, implement and leverage planning systems and tools, ensuring their effective implementation, utilization and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Drive supply chain visibility, transparency, alignment and continuous improvement through regular reporting and communication of global planning metrics, forecasts, and performance updates to key stakeholders through the S&OP process.
  • Stay updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in global planning and supply chain management, incorporating relevant insights into the planning processes.
  • Participate in (Lead) cross-functional projects and initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, mitigate risks, and support strategic objectives.
  • Maintain close coordination with ALAM sales, products, customer service and AL affiliates to ensure reliability of supply.
  • Drive adherence to and refinement of the ALAM S&OP process & performance especially in the areas of demand, supply, capacity, inventory.
  • Drive cross functional alignment and accountability through process performance metrics, execution reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Manage supply chain development and activation for new molecules or new sites
  • Identify, initiate & lead continuous improvement initiatives improving supply chain effectiveness across multiple sites & the global supply chain.
  • Lead supply chain taskforce coordinating all activity internal and external to facilitate required supply to ALAM customers.
  • Facilitate and act as single point of contact for affiliate communications during supply chain taskforce
  • Act as a formal mentor to Finite or Global planning team members
  • Writing of SOP’s, SWI’s, scheduling guidelines and competencies for S&OP and other planning related actions.
  • Drive and replicate supply chain operational excellence and best practices across multiple sites.

Are you a MATCH?

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, operations management, engineering or a related field. Master's degree is a plus.
  • At least more than 5 years of proven experience in global planning, supply chain management, or related roles within a complex manufacturing or distribution environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret and analyze large datasets and make data-driven decisions.
  • Proficient in using planning software and tools, such as ERP systems, demand planning software, and capacity modeling tools.
  • Knowledge of lean and continuous improvement principles, with experience in driving process optimization and efficiency gains. (Green or Black Belt certification)
  • Familiarity with global trade regulations, logistics, and inventory management practices. (w/certifications)




Remark

  • Persons eligible for veteran benefits and employment protection will be given preference according to relevant laws.
  • Applicants must not have any restrictions that disqualify them from overseas travel.
  • Foreign nationals must have residency status that permits employment activities in South Korea.
  • The company reserves the right to withdraw the offer if it discovers subsequently that a candidate has given false information in application or has provided false or fraudulent documentation in support of his/her application.


Recruitment Process

Application → Interview(s) → Offer proposal → Employment contract → Onboarding

jobs.description:

바이탈에어코리아는 윤리적인 기업 문화를 바탕으로 직원 정서적 및 신체적 안전을 최우선으로 여기며, 다양한 커리어 개발 기회와 교육 지원을 통해 직원 개개인의 눈부신 성장을 이끌어갑니다.

또한, 직원의 든든한 일상을 위해 아래의 대표적인 제도들을 필두로 다양한 복리후생 프로그램을 운영하고 있습니다:
- 단체보험, 건강검진, 법률 자문
- 매칭펀드, 우리사주 제도 (2021년 이래 73% 성장)

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

  • 담당지역: 서울, 인천, 경기도

  • 환자 자택 및 병원 방문하여 호흡 질환 환자를 위한 인공호흡기 또는 산소 발생기 설치 및 관리

  • ERP 관리 : 내부 시스템 의료기기 설치, 회수, 교체 정보 입력 및 확인

  • 의료진과 협력하여 환자 관리 및 문제 해결

  • 인공호흡기와 산소발생기 사용법 교육 제공

  • 환자의 안전과 웰빙을 최우선으로 생각

  • 신입 가능

  • 초대졸 이상 졸업자

  • 운전 가능자 (운전 면허증 필수)

  • 방문 서비스나 병원 업무 경험은 더욱 우대 (임상병리사, 응급구조사, 간호사 등)

  • 평일 야간, 주말/공휴일 당직 가능하신 분

  • 「국가보훈 기본법」 제3조제2호에 따른 국가보훈대상자로서 국가보훈관계 법률에 따른 취업지원대상자는 관련법률에 의거하여 우대

  • 해외여행 결격사유가 없는자

  • 외국인의 경우 대한민국 내 취업활동을 할 수 있는 체류자격을 보유한 자

AoDoc #722
The primary focus of the Engineering department is to lead and execute large, mid size capital projects and smaller continuous improvement projects related to commercial chemical manufacturing processes. The process engineer will act as the central process engineering subject matter expert and perform/manage all aspects of process engineering activity for the projects executed in support of major product lines and manufacturing areas, providing technical insights, leadership, and disciplined project management for implementation of chemical process intensive projects.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
● Provide Process Engineering and Technical leadership for capital projects.
● Troubleshoot problems in manufacturing processes
● Improve the safety of existing manufacturing installations
● Identify and implement methods for manufacturing cost reduction in line with
business needs
● Provide process engineering expertise across various product lines and sites
● Develop practical solutions to complex technical problems
● Document and communicate institutional knowledge throughout the organization
● Make quantitative, fact-based decisions
● Actively engage with the project manager to ensure projects are on time, on budget, deliver the required quality
● Develop training materials for Operations technicians. Participate in the technician qualification process by providing classroom instruction on basic principles,
troubleshooting and process specifics.

Are you a MATCH?

  • BS or MS in Chemical Engineering

● 13 or greater years of experience designing, commissioning and starting up
chemical plants, performing hands-on optimization of specialty
chemicals/gases production units
● Demonstrated project planning and management expertise
● Proven track record of delivering on commitments
● Proven ability to lead change, personally adaptable, and able to perform well under pressure and constantly changing priorities
● Solution/outcome oriented in an environment with minimal supervision

● Strong understanding of chemical engineering fundamentals
● Ability to fluently speak in English and Korean.
● Problem solving and decision making skills
● Excellent verbal and written communication skills
● Working knowledge of PLC and DCS control systems
● Process hazard analysis leadership; LOPA and HAZOP
● Cost/benefit analysis, including DCF analysis
● Development and use of metrics for performance management

jobs.title: Researcher
jobs.description:
에어리퀴드는 주요 산업(석유화학, 정유, 철강, 자동차, 신재생에너지 등)에 산업용 가스 및 관련 서비스를 제공하여 성장에 기여하고 환경 친화적인 요구를 충족시켜 왔습니다. 또한 수소에너지 등을 통해 미래 친환경 에너지 사업의 기반을 다지기 위해 노력하고 있습니다.

Within the framework of the R&D strategy and roadmap, support or perform research projects in labs, whatever the research subject, in order to develop technologies and innovations for our internal and external clients.
Lab could be considered as internal Lab or external partnerships (eg. universities, start-ups)

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

Job description:

Development of novel organometallic or silicon-based compounds (including synthesis, purification, and analysis) for ALD/CVD thin film processing.

Company and team:

Air Liquide (AL) has been the world leader in gases, technologies and services for industry and health since 1902. Currently AL is present in 80 countries with more than 66,000 employees. This position will be for a researcher of Metal Oxides and Nitrides group in Air Liquide Laboratories Korea (Seoul). He/she will be responsible for synthesizing new organometallic precursors for ALD/CVD technology and developing cutting-edge technologies for the semiconductor industry. The researcher will work in a multicultural environment and closely with internal and external customers and partners.

Required skills:

We are seeking a skilled chemist with extensive experience in the design, synthesis and purification of organometallic and/or silicon-based compounds.

The main responsibilities will be:

  • Design and synthesis of organometallic and/or silicon-based compounds and purification

  • Analysis using NMR, TGA, DSC, mass spectrometry, etc.

  • Timely and concise reporting (R&D reports, patent applications, internal meetings, customer meetings, etc.)

  • Lead and organize the tasks within work packages/project

  • Mentoring junior scientists and interns

  • Support interactions within Air Liquide group and with other customers

  • Join the safety activities

Are you a MATCH?

  • Minimum: Related M.S degree with 3-5 year experience

  • English: Business Proficient

  • Korean: Conversation level is a plus.

  • Fully autonomous scientist

  • Being experienced in handling pyrophoric, toxic, and combustible materials is a strong asset; the chemist would need to timely learn if not experienced

Preferred Requirements

  • Ph.D with some additional experience or Postdoc

  • Korean: Conversational level

  • Experience in CVD/ALD is preferred

  • Experience in a private or academic R&D lab handling gases is preferred

Recruitment Process

  • Application → Interview(s) → Offer proposal → Employment contract → Onboarding

Remark

  • Persons eligible for veteran benefits and employment protection will be given preference according to relevant laws.

  • Applicants must not have any restrictions that disqualify them from overseas travel.

  • Foreign nationals must have residency status that permits employment activities in South Korea.

  • The company reserves the right to withdraw the offer if it discovers subsequently that a candidate has given false information in application or has provided false or fraudulent documentation in support of his/her application.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
바이탈에어코리아는 2006년부터 만성폐쇄성폐질환, 만성호흡부전, 폐쇄성수면무호흡증 등 호흡기 질환 환자를 대상으로 의료기기에 적용된 홈헬스케어 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다. 바이탈에어는 에어리퀴드의 글로벌 홈헬스케어 브랜드입니다.

Our company provides nationwide home therapy services (such as Sleep Apnea, Long Term Oxygen, Home Mechanical Ventilation and other therapies) by renting our group's validated medical devices. Our company's personalized patient care management, clinical experience among employees, and nation-wide presence are key differentiators for receiving patient therapy prescription referrals from physicians at hospitals.
The Marketing Manager, Home Healthcare, will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to drive patient acquisition, value-based and patient-centric service, and market share growth for our home therapies in respiratory and other diseases in South Korea.

This role will focus on reaching patients with chronic respiratory and other diseases (e.g., COPD, NMD, sleep apnea) and their caregivers, as well as building strong relationships with healthcare professionals and key stakeholders.

The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of how service is valued, the South Korean healthcare landscape, strong digital marketing expertise, and a passion for improving the lives of patients with chronic respiratory conditions.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with pulmonologists, respiratory therapists, ENT doctors, neurologists and other healthcare professionals.

  • Organize and participate in medical conferences, seminars, and workshops.

  • Develop and distribute educational materials for healthcare professionals.

Digital Marketing & Content Creation:

  • Develop and manage digital marketing campaigns across various channels, including SEO/SEM, social media, email marketing, and online advertising.

  • Create engaging and informative content for websites, social media, and marketing materials, tailored to the South Korean audience.

  • Manage and optimize the company's online presence, including website and online patient portals.

Key Opinion Leader of HealthCare Professional Engagement: (while Sales manager is responsible for developing/ managing HeathCareProfessionals)

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with pulmonologists, respiratory therapists, ENT doctors, neurologists and other healthcare professionals.

  • Organize and participate in medical conferences, seminars, and workshops.

  • Develop and distribute educational materials for healthcare professionals.

Patient & Caregiver Engagement:

  • Develop and implement patient education programs and support initiatives.

  • Create and manage patient advocacy programs and online communities.

  • Organize and participate in patient outreach events and health fairs.

Brand Management & Communication:

  • Ensure consistent brand messaging and positioning across all marketing channels.

  • Develop and manage public relations activities and media relations.

  • Monitor and manage online reputation.

Data Analysis & Reporting:

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns.

  • Generate regular reports and presentations to communicate marketing results to management.

  • Utilize CRM software to manage leads and patient interactions.

Compliance:

  • Ensure all marketing activities comply with South Korean healthcare regulations and ethical guidelines.

Are you a MATCH?

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field

  • 7+years of marketing experience, preferably in respiratory care or other home healthcare.

  • Strong understanding of the South Korean healthcare market and regulatory environment.

  • Proven track records of developing and executing successful marketing campaigns.

  • Excellent digital marketing skills, including SEO (Search Engine Optimization)/ SEM (Search Engine Marketing), social media, and content marketing.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with healthcare professionals and patients.

  • Fluency in Korean and English (both written and spoken).

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and AI (Gemini) is preferred

  • People Management experience is preferred

Recruitment Process

  • 이력서 접수 → 면접전형 → 급여책정→ 근로계약서 서명 → 입사

  • Application → Interview(s) → Offer proposal → Employment contract → Onboarding

Remark:

  • 「국가보훈 기본법」 제3조제2호에 따른 국가보훈대상자로서 국가보훈관계 법률에 따른 취업지원대상자는 관련법률에 의거하여 우대

  • 해외여행 결격사유가 없는자

  • 외국인의 경우 대한민국 내 취업활동을 할 수 있는 체류자격을 보유한 자

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Air Liquide Advanced Materials (ALAM) is transforming the science of electronics and technology. We innovate with atomic scale engineering to open up countless new possibilities in how the world lives, works and connects. Today, our ALOHATM and Voltaix® products are critical to the manufacture of the newest computer chips required for Big Data and the Internet of Things. To enhance our execution from discovery to delivery we are adding talented people to our team.

Prevents Equipment Failures utilising data and digital tools and accepted Failure Analysis Methodology Originates and develops analysis methods to determine reliability of components, equipment and processes. Acquires and analyzes data. Prepares diagrams, charts, drawings, calculations and reports to define reliability problems and make recommendations for improvements. Conducts analysis of reliability problems and investigates to determine the required reliability approach for a particular situation, with consideration given to cost limitations for equipment uptime/downtime, repair/replacement costs and weight, size and availability of materials/equipment. Determines cost advantages of alternatives and develops action plans that comply with internal/external customer demands for reliable processes/equipment to avoid failures.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

  • Gather and examine basic reliability data from field studies or database/equipment history and correlate the data for analysis using well-defined engineering techniques, principles and procedures, develop gap analysis and propose improvement plans.

  • Analyze entities’ reliability performance and communicate gaps and progress of entities to the country managers/Operations director and Cluster management team

  • Leads and assists others actively in Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCA) to avoid future failures and follow-up on actions identified and provide RCA training

  • Prioritize and follow-up and close critical reliability initiatives/programs by the Group

  • Determine critical spare parts and appropriate stocking levels.

  • Responsible for the entity Technical Review meeting and Champion the reliability program not limited to using interlex reliability information to work on the analysis; develop statistical analysis dashboard and implement the program based on the analysis.

  • Provide appropriate metrics e.g.: Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF), Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) & etc.

  • Participate in plant shutdowns to improve knowledge and assist in operational troubleshooting.

  • Adherence to Job Order / Work Permit system and to maintain zero accident by complying to all Safety rules & regulations in accordance with Air Liquide IMS and Workplace Safety & Health Act.

Are you a MATCH?

  • Degree in Mechanical/Instrumentation/Chemical/Electrical or related Engineering field

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in maintenance / service / commissioning in the Oil and Gas or petrochemical industry especially in electrical, instrumentation, and control.

  • Possesses a Continuous Improvement mindset.

  • Experience in Root Cause Analysis methodology and Failure Modes.

  • Experience in Asset management is an advantage

  • This role will be remunerated based on the domestic package.

**We thank you for your interest in Air Liquide. Interested applicants are encouraged to send in a detailed resume, including reasons for leaving for past employment. Please be informed that only shortlisted candidates would be notified.**

#LI-SP1

About Air Liquide

A world leader in gases, technologies and services for Industry and Health, Air Liquide is present in 72 countries with approximately 67,800 employees and serves more than 4 million customers and patients. Oxygen, nitrogen and hydrogen are essential small molecules for life, matter and energy. They embody Air Liquide’s scientific territory and have been at the core of the company’s activities since its creation in 1902.

Our Differences make our Performance

At Air Liquide, we are committed to build a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the diversity of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders and cultures across the world.We welcome and consider applications from all qualified applicants, regardless of their background. We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

jobs.title: Specialty Gas (SG) ID Manager
jobs.description:
Air Liquide began operations in Malaysia in 1927 and is one of the pioneers of the gas industry in Malaysia. Operating in 11 locations in Malaysia, comprising both sales offices and production facilities, Air Liquide supports our customers through providing innovative solutions at every step of their production, including industrial and specialty gases, energy solutions, application technologies and services. With a strong workforce of 400 employees and business growth through our recent acquisition with nationwide presence, this will provide an exciting experience and journey with the opportunity that is unique yet challenging to gauge the integration and synergy processes that will change the entire competition landscape in Malaysia.

Summary:
The Specialty Gas Manager acts as the bridge between Group strategies and local operations. The core mission is to drive industrial performance, ensure strict compliance with Group standards for Specialty Gases (SG), and serve as the Business Process Owner (BPO) to optimize workflows and asset utilization across the cluster.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

  • Collaborate with the Cluster Packaged Gas team to drive the Cluster’s industrial performance strategy, ensuring strict adherence to the PMS framework, governance, and reporting standards while leading regular performance reviews to meet Group-aligned targets.

  • Oversee the quality implementation of corrective actions and mandatory programs, ensuring key lessons are documented and shared, while actively collaborating with the Cluster team to secure funding for critical Group Industrial Initiatives.

  • Drive the strategic planning process by acting as the technical authority for some entities’ assets, proactively managing asset renewal and asset extension lifetime studies, and assessing equipment utilization rates to propose such as reallocation plans that optimize Cluster’s resources.

  • Lead the end-to-end management of selected Cluster industrial projects—from aligning with the entities on project selection to collecting subsidiary specifications—while supervising the execution of core missions to ensure they meet industrial and business performance targets.

  • Collaborate with procurement and global entities to optimize the total landed cost and reliability of raw material and product supply chains at EAP boundaries, while defining weekly/monthly (S&OE) and annual (S&OP) planning to support strategic planning.

  • Supervise the execution of core missions, monitoring their impact on industrial performance and setting action plans accordingly.

  • Maximize profitability within EAP boundaries by jointly reviewing entity setups and trading product portfolios, while actively monitoring asset profitability across Business Lines to propose and drive improvement plans.

  • Collaborate with procurement and the operations controller to define long-term third-party sourcing strategies, commercial development plans, and precise landed cost allocations (localizing Group policies) to establish minimum costing guidelines.

  • Lead the deployment of standards, mandatory SG programs, and the digital roadmap across the Cluster, acting as the Business Process Owner to steer implementation, close compliance gaps, and ensure strict adherence to Group policies for assets and processes.

  • Drive knowledge transfer and competency development through field coaching and engage expert support to subsidiaries, while closely collaborating with entities and global stakeholders to implement technical standards and value initiatives.

jobs.title: [상시 채용] 홈헬스케어 부문 신입 및 경력직 모집 - 전국 8개 지사
jobs.description:

바이탈에어코리아에 관심 갖고, 지원해주셔서 감사합니다.

1) 상시 채용이란, 상시 모집을 통하여 일정기간 동안 지원 기회를 열어두어, 이력서를 미리 받아놓은 뒤, 향후 해당 부문 인재 채용 필요시, 적합한 지원자분과 다음 채용 프로세스를 진행하는 방식입니다. 해당 방식은 바로 채용이 진행되지 않더라도 지속적으로 입사 지원을 받으며, 이력서를 등록해주시면 향후, 해당 부문에 채용을 진행하게 될 경우, 연락 드릴 예정입니다.
2) 이력서 및 자기소개서는 PDF 파일로 첨부 부탁 드립니다.

*문의 사항 있으실 경우, kr-career@airliquide.com 로 메일 주시기 바랍니다.

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

1) 의료기기 기술지원 엔지니어 (Medical Equipment Technician)

  • 환자 자택 및 병원 방문하여 호흡 질환 환자를 위한 의료기기 설치 및 관리

  • ERP 관리 : 내부 시스템 의료기기 설치, 회수, 교체 정보 입력 및 확인

  • 의료진과 협력하여 환자 관리 및 문제 해결

  • 의료기기 사용법 교육 제공

2) 홈헬스케어 고객 상담 및 관리직 (Patient Support Consultant)

  • 콜 상담 업무

  • 콜 녹취 및 CTI 관련 업무

  • 관련 부서(영업, 가정방문팀, 컨설턴트 등)와의 소통 및 일정 조율

  • 카카오 & 카이린 앱 1:1 상담 채널 관리

  • 의료기기 교체 및 반납 관리

  • 고객 정보 관리

  • 갱신 처방전 및 관련 서류 관리

  • 소모품 판매/발송/주문 관리

3) 방문 간호사 (Home Visit Nurse)

  • 환자분들 컨디션 점검 (외근: 병원 또는 환자 자택 정기 방문 예정)

  • 의료기기 사용 및 관리 방법에 대한 교육 제공

  • 의료기기 소모품 교체 및 점검

  • 의료기기 유지 보수

4) 국내 영업직 (Sales Representative)

  • 담당지역 병원 정기 방문: 제품 홍보, 고객 관리 및 의료기기 설치

  • 의료진 및 환자 대상, 제품/서비스 관련 의학정보 제공 및 상담 진행

  • 신규거래처 개발 및 관리, 개인목표달성

  • 기존 거래처 (병원)와의 중장기적인 신뢰 관계 구축

  • 브랜드 및 제품 홍보 활동 진행 (학회 및 설명회 참석 등)

Are you a MATCH?

*전국 직영 사무소 위치

- 서울 / 원주 / 대전 / 대구 / 광주 / 전주 / 부산 / 제주

1) 의료기기 기술지원 엔지니어

  • 초대졸 이상

  • 경력 무관

  • 운전 면허증 보유자

  • 평일 야간, 주말/공휴일 당직 가능하신 분

2) 홈헬스케어 고객 상담 및 관리직

  • 초대졸 이상

  • 경력 무관

  • 평일 야간, 주말/공휴일 분기별 1회 당직 근무 가능하신 분

3) 방문 간호사

  • 초대졸 이상

  • 간호사 경력 최소 2년 이상 보유자

  • 간호사 자격증 보유자

  • 운전 면허증 보유자

4) 국내 영업직

  • 학사 이상

  • 경력 무관

  • 운전 면허증 보유자

비고

  • 「국가보훈 기본법」 제3조제2호에 따른 국가보훈대상자로서 국가보훈관계 법률에 따른 취업지원대상자는 관련법률에 의거하여 우대

  • 해외여행 결격사유가 없는자

  • 외국인의 경우 대한민국 내 취업활동을 할 수 있는 체류자격을 보유한 자

  • 지원서의 기재사항이 사실과 다른 것으로 확인되거나 채용상의 결격사유가 확인될 경우 합격 또는 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

#LI-SK1

About Air Liquide

산업용 가스 및 홈헬스케어 가스, 관련 기술 및 서비스 분야의 세계적인 리더인 에어리퀴드는 78개국에 약 64,500명의 직원이 근무하고 있으며 380만 명 이상의 고객과 환자에게 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다. 산소, 질소 및 수소는 생명, 물질 및 에너지에 필수적인 작은 분자입니다.
이는 에어리퀴드의 과학적 영역을 구현하며 1902년 창립 이래로 핵심적인 비즈니스 분야입니다.

Our Differences make our Performance

에어리퀴드는 우리의 직원, 고객, 환자, 지역사회 관계자 및 전 세계 문화의 다양성을 포용하는 다양하고 포용적인 근무 환경을 구축하기 위해 최선을 다하고 있습니다.
우리는 배경에 관계 없이 지원 자격을 갖춘 모든 지원자의 입사 지원을 환영합니다.
에어리퀴드는 다양성을 갖춘 조직이 개인적 집단적으로 사람들이 자신의 재능을 표현할 수 있는 기회를 열어주며, 기본 원칙에 따라 생활하고, 성공을 위해 행동하며, 변화하는 세상에서 참여적인 환경을 조성함으로써 혁신 능력을 키우는 데 도움이 된다고 굳게 믿습니다.

롯데케미컬과 에어리퀴드코리아가 함께 설립한 "롯데 에어리퀴드 에너하이" (이하 에너하이)에서 대산 고압 수소 출하 센터를 2025년 하반기에 출범할 예정입니다.
친환경 수소 에너지의 미래를 함께할 여러분의 참여를 기다립니다.

본 채용은 상시 채용 공고로 상시 모집을 통하여 일정기간 동안 지원 기회를 열어두어, 이력서를 미리 받아놓은 뒤, 향후 해당 부문 인재 채용 필요시, 적합한 지원자분과 다음 채용 프로세스를 진행하는 방식입니다. 해당 방식은 바로 채용이 진행되지 않더라도 지속적으로 입사 지원을 받으며, 이력서를 등록해주시면 향후, 해당 부문에 채용을 진행하게 될 경우, 연락드릴 예정입니다.

- 공장 유지보수 및 안전 관리

- 관련 규정 준수, KGS 및 KOSHA 정기 안전점검 지원(PSM/ SMS).

jobs.title: Senior Data engineer, Corporate Research Laboratory-Asia
jobs.description:
3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.

Job Description:

The 3M Corporate Research Laboratories (CRL) drive breakthrough innovation across the company by developing advanced technologies that enable new products and strengthen core businesses. CRL scientists and engineers collaborate across global research teams to explore emerging materials, process technologies, and digital solutions that support 3M’s long‑term growth. The organization combines deep technical expertise with a culture of curiosity, creativity, and scientific excellence.

3M 중앙연구소(Corporate Research Laboratories, CRL)는 첨단 기술 개발을 통해 혁신을 주도하며 새로운 제품 창출과 핵심 사업 강화를 지원합니다. CRL의 연구원과 엔지니어들은 글로벌 연구 네트워크와 협력하여 신소재, 공정 기술, 디지털 솔루션 등 미래 기술을 탐구하고 3M의 장기적인 성장을 뒷받침합니다. CRL은 깊이 있는 기술 전문성과 호기심, 창의성, 과학적 우수성을 기반으로 혁신 문화를 발전시키고 있습니다.

The person hired for the position of Senior data engineer, Corporate Research Laboratory Asia will support the application of Corporate Research Laboratory informatics across Asia R&D, with emphasis on data architecture, data integration, data governance practices, and development of localized digital applications that enable scientific, technical, and operational insights.

Primary Responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to the following:

  • Design and implement scalable data architectures to support Asia lab. informatics needs.

  • Lead data integration efforts across laboratory systems, research platforms, and regional data sources.

  • Establish and maintain data governance standards aligned with global practices, ensuring data quality, consistency, and compliance with internal requirements.

  • Develop, tailor, and maintain local digital applications and analytical tools that support Asia R&D workflows.

  • Build and manage data pipelines, models, and dashboards to support research, experimentation, and decision-making.

Senior Data Engineer, Corporate Research Laboratory Asia포지션은 Corporate Research Laboratory의 인포매틱스 적용을 아시아 R&D 전반에 지원하며, 데이터 아키텍처, 데이터 통합, 데이터 거버넌스, 그리고 과학·기술·운영 인사이트를 제공하는 지역 디지털 애플리케이션 개발에 중점을 둡니다.

주요 업무 책임은 다음과 같으나, 이에 제한되지는 않습니다. :

  • 아시아 연구소의 인포매틱스 요구를 지원하기 위한 확장 가능한 데이터 아키텍처 설계 및 구현

  • 실험실 시스템, 연구 플랫폼, 지역 데이터 소스 간 데이터 통합 주도 글로벌 기준과 일치하는 데이터 거버넌스 표준 수립 및 유지

  • 데이터 품질·일관성·내부 요건 준수 확보 아시아 R&D 업무를 지원하기 위한 디지털 애플리케이션 및 분석 도구 개발·맞춤화·유지

  • 연구, 실험, 의사결정을 지원하기 위한 데이터 파이프라인, 모델, 대시보드 구축 및 관리

Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or electrical engineering or a related field from an accredited institution

  • Data engineering experience with a background in chemistry or materials science is preferred

  • Min. Two years of data engineering or cloud development experience in a private, public, government or military environment

  • Must have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to excel in cross-functional environments

  • Must be highly motivated, self-starting and a creative problem solver


  • 컴퓨터 공학, 전기공학 또는 관련분야 학사 학위 이상 취득자
    또는 화학/재료 분야 전공자이면서 Data engineering 분야 경력이 있는 자

  • 민간, 공공, 정부 또는 군 환경에서 2년 이상의 데이터 엔지니어링 또는 클라우드 개발 경험

  • 뛰어난 대인 관계 능력을 갖추고 유관부서와 탁월하게 협업할 수 있어야 합니다.

  • 높은 동기부여를 갖고 주도적으로 업무를 시작하며 창의적으로 문제를 해결할 수 있어야 합니다.


  • Master or Ph.D. degree in computer science or electrical engineering or a related field from an accredited institution

  • Direct expertise in AWS cloud development including knowledge of DynamoDB, AWS lambda, Glue, Batch, S3, EFS, EBS, FSx, DataSync, Amazon Sagemaker, Jupyter, and distributed computing platforms such as Spark, auth0 and Active Directory

  • Expertise in software development including Python (and SciPy stack), JavaScript, Matlab, GitHub, Drone CI

  • Expertise in database creation and management including SQL and noSQL databases.

  • Expertise with web application and data visualization methodologies including React/Redux, HTML, Django/Flask, Django REST framework, Dash/Plotly, and Power BI.

  • Drive advanced model adoption through rigorous understanding and application of the state-of-the-art data science methodologies.

  • Develop and implement descriptive models, predictive models, classification algorithms, neural network models, and machine learning-based algorithms.


  • 컴퓨터 공학, 전기공학 또는 관련 분야 석사 또는 박사 학위

  • DynamoDB, AWS Lambda, Glue, Batch, S3, EFS, EBS, FSx, DataSync, Amazon Sagemaker, Jupyter, Spark 등 분산 컴퓨팅 플랫폼, auth0, Active Directory 등 AWS 클라우드 개발에 대한 직접적인 전문성

  • Python(및 SciPy 스택), JavaScript, Matlab, GitHub, Drone CI 등 소프트웨어 개발 분야의 전문성

  • SQL 및 NoSQL 데이터베이스를 포함한 데이터베이스 구축 및 관리에 대한 전문성

  • React/Redux, HTML, Django/Flask, Django REST framework, Dash/Plotly, Power BI 등 웹 애플리케이션 및 데이터 시각화 기법에 대한 전문성

  • 최신 데이터 과학 기법을 깊이 이해하고 적용하여 고급 모델 도입을 추진

  • 기술통계 모델, 예측 모델, 분류 알고리즘, 신경망 모델, 머신러닝 기반 알고리즘 개발 및 구현

Condition

  • Type: 정규직 (수습기간 3개월)

  • Location: 한국3M 서울 동탄 기술연구소 (경기 화성시 삼성1로5길 7)

Application Guidelines (입사 지원 시 주의사항)

  • Click ‘Apply ’ button

  • Fill in basic information such as employment and education

  • Upload your both of Korean/English Resume (merge your files into one file )(이력서 내 경력기술서 및 자기소개서 포함)

Others

  • 해외여행에 결격사유가 없어야 합니다.

  • 국가유공자 및 보훈대상자(veteran) 은 관련 법규에 따라 우대 합니다. (지원 시 Veteran 관련 질의에 YES 선택)

  • 허위사실 기재 시 채용 취소됩니다.

  • 모든 지원자분들께 결과 안내를 드리고 있습니다. 다만, 각 전형별 합격자에게 우선 안내해 드리는 점 양해 부탁드립니다.

Job Description:

The person hired for the position of senior research engineer, Corporate Research Laboratory-Asia will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

  • Lead the development of a fundamental understanding of the mechanical behavior of 3M materials and products.

  • Perform mechanical testing and analysis for soft materials, polymers and adhesives.

  • Develop novel test methods for polymers and adhesives.

  • Collaborate with a cross-functional team of application engineers, scientists, and process engineers to enable next-generation products via Multiphysics/Finite Element Analysis modeling and simulation

  • Support simulation engagements with customers

  • Provide guidance for development of novel materials that meet mechanical requirements of applications.

  • Interface with customers to define problems and develop solutions.

  • Understand, develop, and guide the establishment of digital twins.

  • Initiate and contribute to the analysis and development of intellectual property

Senior Research Engineer, Corporate Research Laboratory-Asia 포지션에 채용되는 분은 호기심을 발휘하고 전 세계의 가장 혁신적이고 다양한 전문가들과 협업할 기회를 갖게 됩니다. 이 역할에서 귀하는 다음과 같은 방식으로 영향력을 발휘하게 됩니다:

  • 3M 소재와 제품의 기계적 거동에 대한 근본적 이해 개발을 주도

  • 연성 소재, 폴리머, 접착제에 대한 기계적 시험 및 분석 수행

  • 폴리머 및 접착제를 위한 새로운 시험 방법 개발

  • Application Engineer, Scientist, Process Engineer로 구성된 유관부서와 협업하여 Multiphysics/유한요소해석(FEA) 기반 모델링 및 시뮬레이션을 통해 차세대 제품 개발 지원

  • 고객 대상 시뮬레이션 프로젝트 지원

  • 적용 분야의 기계적 요구사항을 충족하는 신소재 개발을 위한 기술적 가이드 제공

  • 고객과 소통하여 문제를 정의하고 솔루션을 개발

  • 디지털 트윈의 이해, 개발 및 구축 방향성 수립에 기여

  • 지적 재산(IP) 분석 및 개발 활동을 시작하고 기여

Required Qualifications

  • Ph.D. degree (completed and verified prior to start) or Masters degree with 5+ years of experience in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or Chemistry

  • Experience in deformable body mechanics

  • Fundamental understanding of soft matter physics and mechanical behavior and polymer synthesis/structure

  • Must have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to excel in cross-functional environments

  • Must be highly motivated, self-starting and a creative problem solver

  • 기계공학, 재료공학, 물리학 또는 화학 분야의 박사 학위 (입사 전 취득) 또는 동일 분야 석사 학위 보유자로 5년 이상의 경력 보유

  • 연성체 (Deformable body) 역학 관련 경험

  • 연성 물질(Soft matter) 물리, 기계적 거동, 폴리머 합성/구조에 대한 기초적 이해

  • 뛰어난 대인 관계 능력을 갖추고 유관부서와 탁월하게 협업할 수 있어야 합니다.

  • 높은 동기부여를 갖고 주도적으로 업무를 시작하며 창의적으로 문제를 해결할 수 있어야 합니다.

Preferred Qualifications

Additional qualifications that could help the candidate succeed even further in this role

  • Experience with python or another programming language

  • Experience with Finite Element Anlysis modeling and simulation

We are seeking an experienced Application Engineer to serve as the Asia Product Specialist for our Respiratory Protection portfolio, including Reusable and Disposable Respirators. As a key technical expert, you will partner closely with customers, sales teams, R&D, regulatory, quality, and manufacturing organizations to drive business growth, support new product commercialization, resolve complex technical challenges, and strengthen customer engagement across the region.

Job Description:

Job Title: Transportation Specialist

Position Summary

The Transportation Specialist is responsible for managing day-to-day transportation operations, including oversight of third-party vendors and freight forwarders. This role ensures efficient, cost-effective, and compliant movement of goods while driving continuous improvement across transportation processes. The specialist will monitor performance, identify opportunities for optimization, and collaborate cross-functionally to enhance service levels and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for onboarding all vendors to our new Control Tower 4PL partner
  • Coordinate and oversee daily transportation activities
  • Manage relationships with 3M vendors, carriers, freight forwarders, and logistics service providers.
  • Ensure timely delivery performance and adherence to service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Monitor shipment status, proactively resolving delays, disruptions, or service issues.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for carriers/transportation vendors and freight forwarders locally.
  • Serve as the key transportation contact for material vendors/suppliers to coordinate shipment readiness, collection planning, and issue resolution
  • Evaluate vendor performance using KPIs such as on-time material readiness, cost, and service quality.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with transportation regulations, trade requirements, and company policies.
  • Review shipping documentation for accuracy (e.g., bills of lading, customs paperwork, invoices).
  • Maintain audit-ready records for all transportation activities.
  • Identify inefficiencies in transportation processes and recommend improvements.
  • Analyze shipping data to drive cost savings, route optimization, and performance enhancements.
  • Lead or support projects related to network optimization, system improvements, and process standardization.
  • Monitor continuous improvement using metrics, root cause analysis, and best practices.
  • Monitor freight spend and identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis for transportation expenses.
  • Ensure cost-effective transportation solutions without compromising service quality.
  • Work closely with supply chain, vendors, procurement, and customer service teams.
  • Align transportation strategies with business needs and customer expectations.
  • Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders and external partners.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • +5 to 7 years of experience in transportation, logistics, or supply chain operations.
  • Experience managing carriers, freight forwarders, or 3PL providers.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Proficiency in transportation management systems (TMS), ERP systems, and Microsoft Excel.
  • 10% of domestic travel to visit local suppliers.
  • Ability to converse in Chinese, Japanese, and English (optional: Korean)

Preferred

  • Experience with international shipping, Air, Ocean and LCL modes, customs processes, and trade compliance.
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, etc.).
  • Familiarity with KPI development and performance reporting.

Key Competencies

  • Transportation management
  • Data analysis and decision-making
  • Process improvement mindset
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Attention to detail and operational discipline
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Boeing Korea is looking for a Logistics Service Representative to support the E737/AEW&C program in Pusan, South Korea. Apply Lean principles, root cause analysis, standard work, visual management, and Kaizen to eliminate waste, improve productivity and flow, reduce cost, and build a sustainable continuous improvement culture.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial/Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, Logistics or related field.

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in manufacturing operations, including experience leading production teams, managing daily operations, and balancing production schedules, demand, resources, quality, and delivery requirements.

  • Strong understanding of structured manufacturing operations, including material and production flow, equipment readiness, process control, standard work, issue escalation, and compliance with quality and safety requirements. Candidates from life sciences, biopharma, medical devices, automotive, semiconductor, electronics, or other quality-focused manufacturing industries will be considered.

  • Excellent decision-making and prioritization skills, with the ability to operate under pressure, manage trade-offs transparently, and lead cross-functional teams through clear and effective communication. Willingness to provide hands-on leadership during critical shop-floor situations

  • Proficiency in ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle, with strong data analysis, forecasting, and reporting skills. Demonstrated experience with continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Language/Environment Requirements:

  • Fluent level of English & Korean in written and verbal communications

  • Ability to travel abroad upon business needs

  • Must have a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record within territory or locations

  • If foreign national, legal work permit is required to pursue employment contract by Korean immigration law

  • Ability to lift, move or carry equipment up to 30lb, any other physical requirements

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • CPIM, CSCP or related professional certification. Strong familiarity with safety, environmental, health (EHS) compliance relevant to biologics/cleanroom environments; experience in biosafety / containment, cleaning validation, or contamination control.

  • Experience in tech transfer, commissioning, qualification / validation (IQ / OQ / PQ) of equipment / facility for biologics manufacturing.

  • Prior leadership experience in cross‑functional continuous improvement projects, cost optimization initiatives, or waste/yield improvement in a biologics or biopharma environment.

jobs.title: Managing Director, North Asia / Korea
jobs.description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Managing Director, North Asia / General Manager, Korea for Beckman Coulter Diagnostics will be responsible for leading a direct and indirect team of approximately 70 sales, service, application, and customer support associates. This role will report to the Vice President of APAC Commercial Management for Beckman Coulter Diagnostics. This critical leader will have responsibility for driving profitable revenue growth and building amazing companies with exceptional culture and engagement. She or he will have the autonomy to drive goals and objectives, measuring and monitoring performance and critically contributing to a holistic strategic and business planning process. This role will get results through outstanding leadership skills, consistently fostering and supporting a culture of continuous improvement, with an eye on reaching optimum performance on an individual and team basis.

This position is part of the Asia Pacific Commercial Management Team located in Seoul, Korea, and directly report to the Vice President of APAC Commercial Management. If you thrive in a dynamic, fast paced and leadership role and want to work to build a world-class Commercial organization—read on.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Develop and lead long-term strategic plan with detailed initiatives to reach customer experience, growth and profitability goals for overall commercial organization in the assigned geography, which including; Develop annual budget based on strategic plan and on achieving above market growth by product line and area; deliver budgeted performance; Define overall strategy for the sales, application, service and technical support functions with short- and long-term plans in place to execute strategy; Create and implement business and market strategy for new and existing service product offerings using input from Business Units and Sales Teams to create effective market growth strategies with continuous improvement mindset.
  • Build a high-performance team (incl. effective change management), supervise the development of direct reports with an active succession plans and drive engagement actions for best place to work culture. Create a compassionate, inclusive, positive environment in each country where employees give their best and wouldn’t dream of leaving. Drive thorough business processes across a decentralized site structure, including strong focus on daily management on the local level by elevating usage of DBS (funnel management, transformational marketing, Kaizen etc.).
  • Ensure strong understanding of the marketplace dynamics including competitive and customer trends. Monitor the scientific and related industry trends, and work with the rest of the APAC/HGM leadership team and global business unit to identify new opportunities and enhance business ventures. Represent the organization in customer negotiations, trade shows, seminars, conferences and other official occasions.
  • Establish processes, metrics, compensation programs to successfully drive commercial functions in alignment with APAC/HGM and global sales.
  • Proactively present, minimize and manage business risks by establishing and implementing policies and procedures that ensures compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a business or life sciences technical field, MBA preferred, with 20 years of work experience in the medical device, healthcare or life science research industry. And at least 10 years of successfully building and leading and engaging a large commercial organization
  • Substantial experience within a fast-growing, complex business arena as General Manager with P&L responsibility in Korea and/or North Asia;
  • Demonstrated strong strategic and analytical skills as well as solid business acumen, experience in profit and loss management and growth achievements;
  • Ability to interface with and lead within a complex regional commercial team to achieve maximum results;
  • Shown successful record in sales/marketing leadership and staff management, while functioning in a fast paced, action-oriented environment

LANGUAGE CAPABILITY: English, and any local language would be a plus

TRAVEL: Estimated 20% of the time.
