jobs.title: Director, Corporate Security (Digital Trust)
jobs.description:
Company Introduction

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did we ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest-growing ecommerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurial surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Job Overview

We are looking for an Corporate IT Security Lead to build and run a scalable security function covering corporate endpoints, workforce access, SaaS, browsers, collaboration platforms and other employee-facing technology.

This is a hands-on leadership role, and the person will be expected to establish repeatable security processes, improve coverage across the corporate technology estate, and reduce reliance on manual security work by embedding controls into platforms and engineering workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Security Strategy and Risk

  • Build and maintain a clear view of the major security risks across corporate endpoints, workforce access, browsers, SaaS and collaboration platforms.
  • Translate those risks into a prioritized security roadmap and practical control requirements.
  • Identify systemic gaps and drive solutions that improve security across the environment rather than addressing issues one system at a time.

Scalable Security Processes

  • Build repeatable processes for assessing corporate technologies, identifying control gaps and tracking remediation.
  • Define clear security baselines, review criteria and exception processes (alongside GRC function)
  • Increase security coverage without linearly increasing team size through automation, standardization, self-service and platform-level controls.
  • Establish metrics for coverage, control effectiveness, exceptions and residual risk.

Security Architecture and Control Effectiveness

  • Define and evolve security expectations for managed devices, browsers, identity and access, SaaS, data handling and privileged activity.
  • Work with IT and engineering teams to implement controls at the platform level wherever possible.
  • Independently verify that important controls are operating as intended rather than relying only on configuration or policy documentation.

Cross-Organization Influence

  • Work with Corporate IT, IAM, Security Engineering and business technology owners to drive improvements across organizational boundaries.
  • Influence technical and operational decisions without requiring direct ownership of the underlying platforms.
  • Provide senior technical judgement on significant corporate security issues, architectural decisions and exceptions.

Team Leadership and Function Building

  • Manage and develop a small Corporate IT Security team while remaining technically involved in the highest-risk and most complex work.
  • Establish a clear operating model, ownership boundaries and prioritisation process for the team.
  • Build tooling, processes and partnerships that allow the team's impact to grow faster than its headcount.
  • Develop team members and determine where additional specialist capability is genuinely required.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in corporate, enterprise or endpoint security within a large or technically complex organization.
  • Good technical depth across endpoint security, identity and access, browser security, SaaS security, data protection and privileged access.
  • Experience building or operating security programs that cover large user and device populations.
  • Demonstrated ability to replace manual or ad hoc security work with repeatable, automated or platform-level controls.
  • Experience managing a small technical security team while remaining hands-on.
  • Strong track record of influencing IT and engineering teams outside the direct reporting line.
  • Comfortable operating across both technical architecture and day-to-day security operations.

Document Return Policy

jobs.title: Director, Cybersecurity Audit & Continuous Assurance
jobs.description:
We are seeking an exceptionally qualified, technical, and data-driven Director of Cybersecurity Audit & Continuous Assurance (Technical Program Management) to join our IT Internal Audit leadership team in Seoul, South Korea. Reporting directly to the Head of IT Audit, this role will serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for enterprise cybersecurity risks and technical audit execution across our high-scale, cloud-native e-commerce platforms.

In an era of hyper-scale e-commerce, traditional periodic auditing alone is insufficient. This leader will lead the execution of our global cybersecurity audit strategy while architecting and scaling an advanced Continuous Cybersecurity Control Monitoring (CCCM) and Automated Assurance Validation framework. By blending deep technical cybersecurity domain expertise with data engineering and analytics capabilities, this role will collaborate with relevant teams to develop methods to enhance identification, measurements, and mitigation of cyber risks across complex, microservice-based engineered systems.

Key Responsibilities

Cybersecurity Audit Strategy & Execution

  • Assist in development and execution of the enterprise cybersecurity audit plan, continuously refining audit coverage based on emerging threats, architectural shifts, and global regulatory mandates.

  • Lead technical audits covering cloud security infrastructure, identity and access management (IAM), zero-trust architecture, CI/CD pipelines, container security, network telemetry, and data loss prevention (DLP).

  • Act as the principal SME within IT Internal Audit for security engineering, cryptography, security operations (SOC), threat hunting, and vulnerability management.

  • Partner closely with Information Security, Compliance, Privacy, Cloud Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, and Software Engineering leadership to drive proactive risk mitigation and remediate audit findings.

  • Provide clear, data-backed reports and briefings to leadership stakeholders

Continuous Monitoring & Assurance Automation

  • Architect and lead the implementation of a continuous cybersecurity control monitoring strategy

  • Design scripts, queries, and automated testing routines to transition high-risk controls from periodic manual sampling to near-real-time automated validation.

  • Work with key stakeholders to develop custom security control dashboards and risk observability tools using automated log ingestion (SIEM/Data Lake) to detect control drift, anomalies, and policy non-compliance instantly.

  • Establish standardized technical audit methodologies, script repositories, automated testing SOPs, and analytics frameworks for the broader IT Audit function.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a quantitative data field, combined with 12+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity engineering, cyber risk, or technical cybersecurity auditing within large-scale or publicly traded technology/e-commerce organizations.

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of cloud security architectures (AWS/Azure), distributed systems, modern API security, microservices, and containerized deployments (Kubernetes/Docker).

  • Deep technical mastery of recognized security frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001/27002, CIS Benchmarks, NIST 800-53, ISMS/K-ISMS-P).

  • Based in (or willing to relocate as an expatriate to) Seoul, South Korea.

  • Fluent in English with strong technical communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience building or managing continuous auditing/monitoring systems, data analytics pipelines, or security control observability frameworks using SQL, Python, or data platform tools.

  • Active professional security credentials such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CRISC, or CCSP.

  • Proven track record auditing or securing hyper-scale e-commerce platforms, payment systems (PCI-DSS), or high-volume transactional microservice environments.

  • Experience utilizing SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, Elastic Search) or cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, AWS Athena/Redshift) to write continuous control monitoring queries and automated alert mechanisms.

  • Familiarity leveraging AI/ML tooling or intelligent automation for anomaly detection, evidence extraction, and risk profiling.

jobs.title: Director, Global Security_Governance & Program Management
jobs.description:
Company Introduction

Coupang Corp. is a Korea-based subsidiary of Coupang, Inc. (NYSE: CPNG), a Fortune 150 global technology company headquartered in Seattle. Serving more than 25 million active customers across Korea, we design products and services around daily life through Coupang, Rocket Delivery, Coupang Eats, Coupang Play and Coupang Pay. Powered by our proprietary AI, engineering and end-to-end fulfillment and logistics infrastructure, our teams move fast to solve complex problems at massive scale. Join us to build from the ground up and shape what comes next for millions of customers every day.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the PMO for Coupang Global Security (CGS), including portfolio planning, prioritization, governance, execution tracking, and executive reporting.
  • Translate CGS strategy into plans, clear milestones, ownership, budgets, risks, and measurable results.
  • Manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs across Loss Prevention, Security Technology, Risk and Resilience, Executive Protection, and Corporate Security.
  • Lead regular business reviews for CGS. Provide clear, data-based updates on performance, priorities, risks, budgets, and decisions required.
  • Develop business cases for major programs, including return on investment, operating impact, resource needs, and expected benefits.
  • Oversee Capex / Opex for the organization, track commitments, forecast spend and ensure delivery within approved budgets.
  • Build and manage a global security and loss prevention governance framework for security policies, standards, procedures, controls, and exceptions.
  • Lead compliance programs and audits. Track findings, corrective actions, owners, due dates, and closure evidence.
  • Build KPI and KRI frameworks, dashboards, and management reports that help leaders understand performance and act.
  • Own the business lifecycle of internal and externally developed products, working with subject matter experts from idea and requirements through launch, adoption, measurement, and improvement.
  • Promote responsible use of AI and automation within CGS. Automate dashboards and repetitive work where this improves speed, quality, and control.
  • Support scalable and centralized security controls across video, access control, intrusion detection, security infrastructure, and data analytics environments.
  • Partner with senior leaders across business units, regions, operations, technology, finance, legal, compliance, and procurement to align plans and deliver outcomes.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of program management, analytics, governance, and compliance professionals, including external support where required.

Academic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business management, engineering, technology, risk management, or related field.
  • Master's degree, such as an MBA, or equivalent advanced professional experience is preferred.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent program management qualification is preferred.
  • Additional qualifications in security, risk, audit, compliance, data analytics, or AI are an advantage.

Experience

  • At least 10 years of relevant experience in program or portfolio management, security, loss prevention, governance, risk and resilience, compliance, strategy, planning, operations, or related areas.
  • At least 3 to 5 years of people leadership experience, preferably in a global and cross-functional environment.
  • Experience leading a PMO or a large portfolio of programs with senior executive visibility.
  • Experience working in physical security, supply chain, logistics, warehousing, retail, e-commerce, or similar operational environment.
  • Experience in governance frameworks, policies, standards, and audit programs.
  • Experience with budgets, business cases, benefits measurement, and executive business reviews.
  • Experience leading or working closely with data analytics, dashboards, automation, or AI-enabled teams.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong knowledge of program, portfolio, and project management methods.
  • Good understanding of security governance, physical security, loss prevention, operational risk, compliance, and audit practices.
  • Ability to build practical policies, standards, controls, and governance processes that can scale across countries and business units.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear actions and decisions.
  • Ability to define meaningful KPIs and KRIs and use dashboards to improve performance and accountability.
  • Strong business and financial understanding, including budgeting, forecasting, return on investment, and cost-benefit analysis.
  • Working knowledge of data analytics, workflow automation, and responsible use of AI in business processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Able to prepare simple executive updates and present complex topics clearly.
  • Strong influence, negotiation, stakeholder management, and consulting skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across regions, cultures, functions, and virtual teams.

Success in This Role

Success will be measured by the quality and speed of portfolio execution, clear executive visibility, stronger policy and compliance management, timely closure of risks and audit actions, reliable performance data, responsible automation, effective budget control, and the development of a high-performing team. The Director must bring structure without creating unnecessary process and must help the full CGS organization deliver as one team.

Recruitment Process and Others

Recruitment Process

  • Application Review - Job Fit Interview - Focus Interview – Offer
  • The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary according to the specific job and may be changed due to scheduling or other circumstances.

jobs.title: Director I, Category Growth & Demand Programs (Rocket Growth)
jobs.description:
About Coupang
At Coupang, we exist to wow our customers. Our mission is to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever before. We’re disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry from the ground up and building a reputation as South Korea’s most innovative and reliable e-commerce platform.
We combine the agility of a startup with the scale and resources of a global public company. This unique blend empowers us to launch new services at speed, drive innovation, and make a tangible impact every day. At Coupang, you’ll grow alongside bold, hands-on, and ambitious teammates who are passionate about shaping the future of commerce.

Team Description:
Rocket Growth business enables small and medium suppliers to offer Rocket Delivery (Dawn and Next Day Delivery) to millions of Coupang customers by allowing the suppliers the use of Coupang’s Fulfillment and Delivery Network. With thousands of new suppliers signing up for Rocket Growth each quarter, it is one of the fastest growing businesses at Coupang. As we get ready to scale this business multi-fold over the next few years, we are looking for a few smart, and driven leaders, who would like to solve tough problems, and make a meaningful impact to the lives of customers and suppliers in one of the biggest e-Commerce markets in the world.

Role Description:
As the Head of Category Growth & Demand for Rocket Growth, you will lead the strategic engine responsible for accelerating seller success and maximizing selection growth. Your mission is twofold:

  • Building scalable, programmatic frameworks that optimize the core levers of e-commerce - such as pricing, conversion, and visibility. Translate data into actionable growth playbooks & programs that empower sellers to accelerate units sold on each of their items listed on Rocket Growth
  • Architecting a high-impact promotions & demand strategy for RG & Sellers. You will sit at the intersection of marketing, product, category teams & sellers, transforming Korea’s largest demand engine into a structured & high-throughput promotions, campaigns & events calendar, that seller can participate & see uplift through.

What you will do:

  • Architect Growth Programs: Identify and prioritize the most critical growth drivers (e.g., Pricing competitiveness, Impression share, Conversion Rate, Review generation). Partner with product teams to build automated, scalable constructs that sellers can opt into to accelerate their performance. Drive adoption, learn, iterate & ensure uplift
  • Enable Brand & Seller Growth: Brand & Seller Growth: Partner with sales team to create playbook for brands on Rocket Growth
  • Lead Promotions & Campaigns: Own the end-to-end promotional charter, including the design of the annual promotion calendar, defining participation criteria for diverse seller tiers, driving high-velocity adoption, feedback loops & impact delivery to sellers.
  • Innovate Demand Channels: Expand the demand generation toolkit by piloting and scaling innovative constructs, including KOL marketing, collabs, and other emerging traffic channels to drive high-intent shoppers to Rocket Growth selection.
  • Optimize Playbooks: Set up rigorous tracking for promotion efficacy and program ROI; use these insights to continuously refine the "Rocket Growth Playbook" and sunset low-impact activities / refine selection & seller participation criteria.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Product, Data Science, Grwoth Marketing, Merchandising and Category teams to ensure growth programs are technically sound, data-backed, and aligned with broader business priorities.
  • Build for Scale: Operate at scale by driving implementation of systemic & product-led solutions that improve customer and seller experience. Design and manage feedback loops from Operations, Business and Suppliers to key technology teams.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Overall Experience: 12+ years of overall professional experience. Relevant experience in an e-commerce or similar high-growth online set-up, specifically in Marketing, Program Management, Product Management, or Category Management.
  • Education: Master’s degree in business fields (Marketing, Operations) preferred
  • Digital Marketing & User Growth: Proven track record in managing full-funnel growth strategies, with deep expertise in performance marketing, CRM, and user lifecycle optimization to drive scalable acquisition and retention.
  • Analytical Rigor: Ability to synthesize complex datasets to identify growth bottlenecks and opportunities and strong data-oriented prioritization; comfort with SQL or advanced Excel is highly preferred.
  • Program Management: Experience in technical program management in a high growth, high SKU count environment (e-Commerce or high SKU count Retail).
  • Impact Delivery at Scale: Demonstrated ability to drive significant impact, revenue & customer growth for $Billion+ businesses
  • Stakeholder Management: Exceptional oral & written communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional partners without authority (Sales, Technology, Marketing, Operations) and lead teams through ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.
  • Adaptability & Innovation: Proven ability to drive 0-1 innovation with an “Aim High & Find a Way” attitude in large organization. Experience working with modern marketing levers such as KOL ecosystems to drive demand is a plus.

jobs.title: Director, Key Account Management (Coupang Eats)
jobs.description:
회사 소개

쿠팡이츠(Coupang Eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다.

쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다.

분야별 전문가들과 더 큰 도전을 통해 함께 성장하고 싶다면, 지금 쿠팡이츠와 함께하세요.

직무 소개

Coupang Eats KAM(Key Account Management) 조직은 국내 주요 Enterprise F&B 브랜드와의 전략적 파트너십을 통해 브랜드의 성장과 Coupang Eats의 지속적인 GMV 성장을 만들어가는 조직입니다.

Director, Key Account Management는 주요 Enterprise 브랜드와의 Strategic Partnership을 이끌고, 브랜드의 Business Performance와 시장에 대한 깊은 이해를 바탕으로 성장 기회와 핵심 Initiative를 발굴·실행하는 역할입니다. 또한 브랜드 C-level과 중장기 Business Agenda를 논의하는 Strategic Partner로서 2개의 KAM Unit을 리딩하고, Team Lead와 AM의 Account Management 및 Consultative Selling 역량을 강화합니다.

업무 내용

  • 국내 주요 Enterprise F&B 브랜드와 전략적 파트너십을 구축하고 C-level을 포함한 주요 Stakeholder와 장기적인 관계 강화
  • 브랜드의 Business Performance와 시장·경쟁 환경을 구조적으로 분석하여 Growth Opportunity를 발굴하고 핵심 Strategic Initiative를 제안·실행
  • Account Planning 및 Joint Business Planning(JBP)을 통해 브랜드와 중장기 Business Agenda를 Align하고 Partnership을 구체적인 실행 계획으로 연결
  • CRM, Promotion, Ads, New Menu 등 다양한 Growth Lever를 활용하여 브랜드별 Tailored Growth Solution 기획 및 실행
  • 2개 KAM Unit의 목표와 성과를 관리하고 Team Lead 및 AM의 Account Management와 Consultative Selling 역량 Coaching
  • Product, Marketing, Ads, Operations, Data 등 Cross-functional 조직을 Align하여 주요 Growth Initiative의 End-to-End 실행 주도

자격 요건

  • 학사 학위 이상
  • 12년 이상의 Enterprise Sales, Key Account Management, Business Development, Strategy 또는 관련 분야 경력
  • 대형 B2B/Enterprise 고객과 전략적 파트너십을 구축하고 장기적인 Business Relationship을 관리한 경험
  • 복잡한 Business Problem을 구조화하고, 데이터와 시장 정보를 기반으로 Growth Opportunity와 실행 가능한 Initiative를 도출한 경험
  • Enterprise 고객의 C-level/ Senior Executive와 전략적 Agenda를 논의하고 Influence할 수 있는 Executive Communication 역량
  • Sales 또는 Account Management 조직을 리딩하고 Manager 및 Senior AM을 Coaching한 경험
  • 다양한 이해관계자를 Align하여 복잡한 Business Initiative를 End-to-End로 실행한 경험
  • KPI 기반의 성과 중심 조직에서 Business Result를 만들어낸 경험

우대 사항

  • Strategy Consulting 또는 In-house Strategy 경험, 혹은 이에 준하는 Structured Problem Solving 및 Consultative Selling 경험
  • F&B, 외식 프랜차이즈, Consumer Brand 또는 Retail 산업 경험
  • Food Delivery, Marketplace, O2O 또는 Platform Business 경험
  • 국내 주요 외식 브랜드 및 프랜차이즈 본사와의 Partnership 경험 또는 Network
  • Enterprise Sales, Strategic Partnerships 또는 Key Account Management 조직 리딩 경험
  • Joint Business Planning(JBP) 또는 Strategic Account Planning 경험
  • CRM, Promotion, Advertising, Product Collaboration 등 다양한 Growth Lever를 활용하여 고객의 Business Growth를 만들어낸 경험
  • 데이터 기반 의사결정 및 Business Performance 개선 경험

전형 절차 및안내사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 - 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
    • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

jobs.title: Director, Legal Counsel (Fair Trade Legal)
jobs.description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

Fair Trade Legal 팀은 쿠팡의 유통 및 풀필먼트 사업 전반에 걸쳐 경쟁법 현안을 전문적으로 다루는 역할을 수행하고 있습니다. 당팀은 공정거래위원회 및 관계부처 소관 법령에 근거하여 사내에서 발생하는 유통 및 플랫폼 관련 주요 이슈를 자문하며, 공정거래위원회 및 유관기관의 조사 대응과 관련 소송 업무를 주도적으로 수행하고 외부 로펌 관리 및 소통을 총괄하며, 급변하는 규제의 최전선에서 쿠팡의 비즈니스가 법적 신뢰에 기반하여 성장과 혁신을 이어가도록 뒷받침합니다.

당팀의 매니저는 사업부 자문, 공정거래위원회의 조사 및 소송 사건에 대한 대응 업무를 주도하는 직책으로, 법무팀, 사업부, 로펌 등과 협업을 하면서 실행 가능한 비즈니스 솔루션을 도출하고 공정거래 규제에 대응하는 중추적인 역할을 하게 됩니다.

업무 내용

  1. 공정거래법, 대규모유통업법, 전자상거래법, 하도급법 등 관련 법령 해석을 기반으로 한 전문성 있는 자문 제공
  2. 공정거래위원회 및 유관기관의 조사 및 자료제출 요구, 관련 소송 등 대응 업무 수행, 사실관계 분석, 소명 논리 및 대응 전략 수립 등 법률 대응 주도, 외부 로펌과의 협업 및 소통 총괄
  3. 공정거래 관련 법률 문서의 검토·작성, 공정거래 관련 법적 리스크를 식별·평가, 리스크 최소화 솔루션 제시
  4. 유통 및 플랫폼 관련 국내외 공정거래 규제 동향 파악 및 예측

자격 요건

  • 국내 변호사 자격증 소지자
  • 변호사 자격 취득 후 공정거래, 유통 분야 경력 10년 이상인 분
  • 빠르게 움직이며 압박이 높은 환경에서 성장과 리스크에 대한 균형 잡힌 판단을 내릴 능력을 갖춘, 비즈니스 중심적인 성과를 지속적으로 이끌어 내는 능력이 탁월한 분
  • 효과적인 구두·서면 커뮤니케이션 능력을 갖추고, 타 부서와의 협업에 적극적인 분
  • 새로운 업무 범위와 도전에 대해 열정적으로 배우고자 하는 자세를 갖추신 분
  • 법적 이슈를 능동적이고 주도적으로 찾아내고, 법리에 근거한 논리적 판단력을 갖추어, 비즈니스의 요청에 민첩하게 대응할 수 있는 분
  • 팀원들의 업무를 원만하고 효과적으로 지휘하면서 부서의 역량 성장에 기여할 수 있는 분

우대 사항

  • 로펌 또는 주요 기업 인하우스 경력 우대
  • 공정거래위원회 조사 대응, 유통·플랫폼 관련 자문 업무 유경험자 우대

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
  • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
  • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
  • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
  • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
  • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
  • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

jobs.title: Director of Back-end Engineering (Rocket Pay)
jobs.description:
Director, Back-end Engineering (Rocket Pay)

Company Introduction

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we are collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry from the ground up and establishing an unparalleled reputation for being leading and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

About the team

We redefine financial services to help Coupang customers and merchants unlock greater value at the same cost. We are dedicated to providing innovative payment and financial solutions to consumers shopping on the Coupang app and website, sellers operating on the Coupang Marketplace, and restaurant owners on Coupang Eats. Powered by Coupay—our proprietary one-touch payment system—Coupang Pay’s fintech innovations meet the evolving needs of consumers across Korea and Taiwan. Notably, we are rapidly scaling the Coupang Wow Card (our co-branded credit card offering industry-leading rewards) while empowering small and medium-sized merchants to grow through Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) models and liquidity solutions. If you want to maximize your experience in the fintech space, join Coupang Pay—where we save customers time at checkout so they have more time to shop for what they love.

Role Overview Coupang Pay is going beyond Coupay to build Rocket Pay, a next-generation universal payment platform designed for tens of millions of customers to use anywhere in their daily lives—extending beyond the Coupang ecosystem to online and offline merchants. Leveraging massive payment traffic and financial data, Rocket Pay delivers entirely new customer experiences.

The Product Engineering organization designs, develops, and operates the core payment systems powering this expansion, including Wallet, Authorization, Settlement, Reconciliation, Merchant Services, and the broader Fintech Platform. Rather than merely shipping features, this organization defines the foundational architecture of a next-generation fintech platform supporting tens of millions of users and tens of trillions of KRW in transaction volume.

As the Director of Back-end Engineering, you will lead multiple Rocket Pay engineering teams and Engineering Managers, translating long-term product vision and business strategy into a multi-year technical strategy and execution roadmap. You will be accountable for organizational scaling, leadership development, architectural excellence, and operational reliability across mission-critical payment domains. You will also partner closely with executive stakeholders across Product, Business, Finance, Risk, and Compliance to drive the expansion of Rocket Pay into an industry-leading universal payment platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic & Technical Leadership: Define the overarching technical vision, system architecture, and multi-year engineering roadmap for Rocket Pay’s core back-end domains (Wallet, Authorization, Settlement, Reconciliation, and Merchant Services).

  • Multi-Team & Manager Leadership: Lead, coach, and scale a high-performing organization of Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, and Senior/Staff Engineers; foster a culture of engineering excellence, ownership, and continuous growth.

  • Cross-Functional Executive Alignment: Partner directly with Product, Business, Finance, Risk, and Compliance leaders to align technical execution with regulatory requirements, financial accuracy, and aggressive business growth targets.

  • Platform Scalability & Reliability: Ensure ultra-high availability, low latency, and strict financial data integrity across systems processing tens of trillions of KRW in transactions; lead architectural reviews and executive deep-dives into critical production incidents.

  • Delivery & Operational Excellence: Drive agile execution across multiple concurrent, mission-critical programs, establishing rigorous engineering, testing, and operational best practices.

Basic Qualifications

  • Solid experience in progressive software engineering, with experience in engineering management, including 2+ years managing Engineering Managers (manager-of-managers experience).

  • Proven track record of defining technical vision and leading the architecture and delivery of large-scale, mission-critical distributed systems.

  • Extensive experience aligning technical roadmaps across senior stakeholders (Product, Business, Risk, Finance) and Principal/Lead Engineers.

  • Strong organizational leadership experience, including hiring, mentoring, performance management, and scaling multi-team engineering organizations in an Agile environment.

  • Deep hands-on architectural understanding of Microservices Architecture (MSA), JPA, and JVM-based ecosystems (Java / Spring / Kotlin).

  • Demonstrated ability to lead root-cause analysis and deep-dives on complex, business-critical system issues.

  • Solid foundation in software engineering fundamentals, automated testing, and industry-standard system design best practices.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in Korean

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Extensive domain experience in Payments, Fintech, Banking, or Financial Services (e.g., authorization, clearing/settlement, ledgers, merchant acquiring, or BaaS).

  • Experience architecting and operating high-throughput, global-scale distributed systems.

  • Deep familiarity with high-volume financial data reconciliation (대사) and strict data consistency/auditability requirements.

  • Hands-on background with cloud-native infrastructure (AWS) and container orchestration (Kubernetes).

  • Experience with large-scale data processing and streaming pipelines utilizing Kafka, Spark, Hadoop, Cassandra, or Airflow.

Recruitment Process and Others

Recruitment Process

  • Application Review - Job Fit Interview - Focus Interview – Offer
  • The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary according to the specific job and may be changed due to scheduling or other circumstances.
  • Interview schedules and the results will be informed to the applicant via the e-mail address submitted at the application stage.

Details to Consider

  • This job posting may be closed prior to the stated end date for application if all openings are filled.
  • Coupang has the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process.
  • Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran’s benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws.
  • Job titles and responsibilities may be subject to change depending on the candidate’s overall experience, etc. This will be communicated to the candidate at the appropriate time before the offer.
  • Hiring may be restricted in case the legal qualifications required for hiring and work performance is not met.
  • This is a full-time regular position and includes 12 weeks of probation period; provided, however, the probationary period may be either skipped, shortened or extended if necessary for business purposes.

Privacy Notice

  • Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below.

https://www.coupang.jobs/en/privacy-policy

Document Return Policy

  1. This notification is given pursuant to Article 11 (6) of the Fair Hiring Procedure Act.
  1. A job applicant, who has applied but not been finally selected for a position at Coupang (the “Company”), may request the Company to return his/her hiring documents submitted pursuant to the Fair Hiring Procedure Act. However, this will not apply where the hiring documents were submitted via the website of the Company or e-mail, or where the job applicant submitted those documents voluntarily without a request from the Company. In addition, if the hiring documents were destroyed due to a natural disaster or any other reasons not attributable to the Company, such documents will be deemed to have been returned to the job applicant.
  1. A job applicant who wishes to request the return of his/her hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above should fill out a “Request for Return of Hiring Documents” [Annex Form No. 3 in the Enforcement Rule of the Fair Hiring Procedure Act] and submit It by email (recruitingops@coupang.com). In such case, within fourteen (14) days from the date of identifying the receipt of the request, the Company will send the hiring documents to the job applicant’s designated address via registered mail. Please be informed that the job applicant is required to pay the postage on the registered mail.
  1. In preparation for a job applicant’s request for the return of hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above, the Company shall retain the original hiring documents submitted by the job applicant for 180 days from the completion of the recruiting process. If no request is made until the end of this period, all his/her hiring documents will be destroyed immediately in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act.
  1. The above paragraphs 1 - 4 shall only apply when the labor-related laws of Korea govern the application. They are otherwise not applicable.

jobs.title: [쿠팡] Director, Pricing Operations Seller Excellence
jobs.description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

PBS (Platform Business Service) 조직의 Pricing Operations 팀은 쿠팡의 가격 경쟁력을 강화하기 위해 시장 가격 데이터를 기반으로 다양한 운영 프로그램과 프로세스를 설계·운영하고 있습니다.

본 포지션은 Pricing Operations 산하 Seller Excellence 조직을 이끄는 리더로서, 시장 가격의 적합성과 가격 경쟁력을 검증하기 위한 프로그램 및 프로젝트를 기획하고 운영합니다. 또한 운영 정책과 프로세스를 수립 및 개선하고, Product·Engineering·Business 조직과의 협업을 통해 운영 효율성과 성과를 지속적으로 향상시키는 역할을 담당합니다.

업무 내용

  • 시장 가격의 적합성과 가격 경쟁력 검증을 위한 Pricing Program 및 Project 기획·운영·성과 관리
  • Pricing Validation, Mystery Shopper Program, Playbook 등 핵심 운영 정책 및 프로그램 수립·고도화
  • Program Owner로서 End-to-End 운영 프로세스 설계, 표준화 및 운영 체계 개선
  • KPI 기반 운영 성과 관리 체계 구축 및 데이터 기반 인사이트 도출
  • Product, Engineering, Business 조직과의 협업을 통한 정책·프로세스·시스템 개선 과제 추진
  • Seller Excellence 조직 운영, 목표 수립, 성과 관리 및 인재 육성
  • 운영 효율화 및 자동화를 위한 프로젝트 기획, 실행 및 변화 관리

자격 요건

  • 10년 이상의 이커머스, 디지털 플랫폼 또는 유관 산업 분야 경험을 보유하신 분
  • Program Management, Project Management 또는 Operations Management 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 운영 정책(Policy), 프로세스(Process), SOP 등 운영 체계를 설계하고 개선한 경험을 보유하신 분
  • Product, Engineering, Business 조직과 협업하여 운영 프로세스 혁신 또는 시스템 고도화 프로젝트를 주도하신 분
  • 15명 이상의 조직을 3년 이상 리딩하며 조직 성과 관리 및 인재 육성 경험을 보유하신 분

우대 사항

  • Pricing, Marketplace, Seller Operations 또는 Operations Excellence 분야 경험을 보유하신 분
  • Mystery Shopper, Audit, Validation, Quality Management 등 운영 품질 관리 프로그램을 기획 또는 운영하신 분
  • SQL, Tableau 등 데이터 분석 도구를 활용하여 운영 성과를 관리하고 인사이트를 도출하신 분

전형 절차 및안내사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 - 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
    • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management (Catalog)
jobs.description:
About Coupang

We exist to wow our customers. We know we're doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, "How did we ever live without Coupang?" Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we're collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest-growing e-commerce companies in the world, establishing an unparalleled reputation as a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

We offer the best of both worlds: a startup culture backed by the resources of a large, global public company. This fuels our continuous growth and enables us to launch new services at remarkable speed. We are entrepreneurial builders surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people who love to roll up our sleeves and make a direct impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve complex problems and break traditional trade-offs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

About the Team

The Coupang Catalog Team is responsible for hosting billions of products in Coupang's catalog and dynamically processing hundreds of millions of daily updates to provide the single source of truth that powers the online buying experience for millions of customers. We strive to deliver a world-class platform where customers find complete, accurate, and trustworthy product information without friction and at the lowest prices. To achieve this at scale, we continuously invest in cutting-edge AI architectures—leveraging modern Large Language Models (LLMs) and advanced machine learning—to ensure maximum precision, dynamic scalability, and bulletproof platform reliability.

About the Role

The Director of Catalog Product will leverage deep expertise in the latest LLM technologies, Generative AI, and advanced machine learning (NLP/NLU, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Algorithmic Modeling) to pioneer next-generation e-commerce solutions. You will design, build, and scale a diverse portfolio of AI-driven products, automation tools, and catalog features that transform how product data is structured, enriched, and presented across Coupang’s vast e-commerce ecosystem.

Operating in a high-growth, rapidly evolving, and often ambiguous environment, you must thrive amidst constant change while maintaining an uncompromising bar for product quality and execution. You will navigate high degrees of operational complexity and drive strategy across international cohorts of senior stakeholders in South Korea, China, and the US (including Retail, Pricing, 3P Marketplace, Search & Discovery, and Finance).

Role Overview

  • Set the vision and strategic roadmap for Coupang's Catalog platform, pioneering the application of cutting-edge LLMs and Gen AI to solve complex e-commerce challenges (e.g., catalog auto-enrichment, dynamic attribute extraction, automated taxonomy classification, seller content optimization, and fraud/quality detection).
  • Lead the entire product lifecycle from conceptual AI frameworks through to production implementation in a high-velocity, continuous-deployment ecosystem.
  • Navigate ambiguity with clarity and conviction, establishing structured roadmaps, making clear trade-off decisions, and maintaining a high standard of quality despite fast-moving constraints.
  • Drive executive alignment across multi-regional leadership in Engineering, Data Science, Product, Operations, and Infrastructure.
  • Establish metrics and build automated mechanisms to track performance, system precision, and operational efficiency across billions of catalog entities.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product management experience successfully developing and launching innovative tech products at a tier-1 technology company.
  • Proven track record of applying state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and ML frameworks to complex, high-scale e-commerce or consumer marketplace applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in highly ambiguous, fast-paced environments, maintaining momentum and producing top-quality outputs under tight timelines and high expectations.
  • End-to-end experience leading product strategy, establishing roadmaps from conception to launch, defining GTM strategies, and leading complex technical design discussions.
  • Deep understanding of the modern AI/ML software stack, model evaluation frameworks, and deployment of LLMs at scale.
  • Experience managing technical and design direction for complex, large-scale distributed systems.
  • Hands-on mastery of agile methodologies in high-velocity environments (rapid prototyping, A/B testing, data-driven evaluation, and fast iteration).
  • Expert capability in using quantitative research, data analysis, and rigorous metrics to drive product decision-making across the product lifecycle.
  • Solid grasp of multi-sided e-commerce marketplace models, catalog architectures, and pricing dynamics.
  • Experience collaborating with and leading cross-functional teams across multiple international geographies.

jobs.title: Director, Program Management (Catalog Product Ops - Marketplace)
jobs.description:
Company Introduction

Coupang Corp. is a Korea-based subsidiary of Coupang, Inc. (NYSE: CPNG), a Fortune 150 global technology company headquartered in Seattle. Serving more than 25 million active customers across Korea, we design products and services around daily life through Coupang, Rocket Delivery, Coupang Eats, Coupang Play and Coupang Pay. Powered by our proprietary AI, engineering and end-to-end fulfillment and logistics infrastructure, our teams move fast to solve complex problems at massive scale. Join us to build from the ground up and shape what comes next for millions of customers every day.

Role Overview

As Director of Training and Quality for our Catalog Operations team, you will play a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement of our labelling and audit operations.You will be responsible for developing and implementing training programs, defining quality metrics, and driving best practices to enhance data label accuracy and operational workflows.
This role requires a strategic thinker with deep expertise in e-commerce Machine Learning Operations, and quality assurance methodologies. You will collaborate closely with data scientists, AI/ML engineers, and operation teams to optimize model development leveraging LLM training protocols, ensure high-quality data inputs to deliver eval and fine-tuning data, and develop and supervise methodologies to measure and improve operator accuracy.

What You Will Do

  1. Training & Development:
    • Design, implement, and continuously improve training programs for ML annotators, reviewers, and operational teams.
    • Develop competency frameworks and certification processes to ensure a high level of accuracy and consistency in ML training.
    • Collaborate with ML engineers and data scientists to align training content with evolving ML models and workflows.
    • Introduce new tools, techniques, and best practices for improving annotation efficiency and decision-making.
  2. Quality Assurance & Process Optimization:
    • Define and implement quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and reliability of labeled data and operational workflows.
    • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to data labelling accuracy, annotation consistency, and operational efficiency.
    • Develop and enforce Standard Operation Procedures (SOPs) to ensure consistency, compliance, and best practices across ML operations.
    • Lead root cause analysis and corrective action initiatives to address quality issues and optimize workflow performance.
    • Work closely with product and engineering teams to enhance automation and improve data validation processes.
  3. Tooling & Technology Enablement:
    • Assess, implement, and optimize tooling solutions for data annotation, quality assurance, and workflow automation.
    • Work with engineering teams to refine and enhance annotation platforms
    • Oversee integration of quality monitoring tools, dashboards, and analytics to track performance and drive insights.
    • Evaluate and implement AI-driven solutions to improve annotation accuracy and reduce manual intervention.
    • Ensure the seamless adoption of new tools through structured training and documentation.
  4. Leadership & Stakeholder Collaboration:
    • Build and lead a team of quality specialists, trainers, and process analysts to support ML operations at scale.
    • Partner with cross-functional teams – including ML engineers, data scientists and operation teams - to align training and quality initiatives with business goals.
    • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging ML technologies, and e-commerce best practices to drive continuous improvement.
    • Advocate for a culture of operational excellence, data integrity, and continuous learning.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in training, quality assurance, or operational leadership within an ML, AI or data driven environment.
  • Analytical mindset with experience using data driven approaches to improve quality and efficiency.
  • Proficiency in quality management methodologies (Six Sigma, Lean, etc)
  • Strong understanding of machine learning concepts, data annotation processes, and model evaluation techniques.
  • Experience in e-commerce operations, ML ops, or technical operation processes.
  • Proven ability to design and implement quality assurance processes that enhance workforce capabilities.
  • Proven ability to design and implement training programs that enhance workforce capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience with tooling selection and implementation for annotation, automation and performance monitoring.
  • Strong expertise in developing, managing and enforcing Standard Operating Procedures for large-scale operations

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with ML annotation platforms (Scale AI, Labelbox, Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth)
  • Familiarity with automation tools, workflow optimization, and AI-assisted quality assurance.
  • Knowledge of compliance and ethical considerations in data labelling and ML training.
  • Proficiency in scripting or dashboarding tools (SQL, Python, Tableau, Looker) to support quality tracking and analytics

Recruitment Process and Others

Recruitment Process

  • Application Review - Job Fit Interview - Focus Interview – Offer
  • The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary according to the specific job and may be changed due to scheduling or other circumstances.
  • Interview schedules and the results will be informed to the applicant via the e-mail address submitted at the application stage.

Details to Consider

  • This job posting may be closed prior to the stated end date for application if all openings are filled.
  • Coupang has the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process.
  • Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran’s benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws.
  • Job titles and responsibilities may be subject to change depending on the candidate’s overall experience, etc. This will be communicated to the candidate at the appropriate time before the offer.
  • Hiring may be restricted in case the legal qualifications required for hiring and work performance is not met.
  • This is a full-time regular position and includes 12 weeks of probation period; provided, however, the probationary period may be either skipped, shortened or extended if necessary for business purposes.

Privacy Notice

  • Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below.

https://www.coupang.jobs/en/privacy-policy

Document Return Policy

  1. This notification is given pursuant to Article 11 (6) of the Fair Hiring Procedure Act.
  2. A job applicant, who has applied but not been finally selected for a position at Coupang (the “Company”), may request the Company to return his/her hiring documents submitted pursuant to the Fair Hiring Procedure Act. However, this will not apply where the hiring documents were submitted via the website of the Company or e-mail, or where the job applicant submitted those documents voluntarily without a request from the Company. In addition, if the hiring documents were destroyed due to a natural disaster or any other reasons not attributable to the Company, such documents will be deemed to have been returned to the job applicant.
  3. A job applicant who wishes to request the return of his/her hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above should fill out a “Request for Return of Hiring Documents” [Annex Form No. 3 in the Enforcement Rule of the Fair Hiring Procedure Act] and submit It by email (recruitingops@coupang.com). In such case, within fourteen (14) days from the date of identifying the receipt of the request, the Company will send the hiring documents to the job applicant’s designated address via registered mail. Please be informed that the job applicant is required to pay the postage on the registered mail.
  4. In preparation for a job applicant’s request for the return of hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above, the Company shall retain the original hiring documents submitted by the job applicant for 180 days from the completion of the recruiting process. If no request is made until the end of this period, all his/her hiring documents will be destroyed immediately in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act.
  5. The above paragraphs 1 - 4 shall only apply when the labor-related laws of Korea govern the application. They are otherwise not applicable.

쿠팡 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

쿠팡이츠서비스 소개

쿠팡이츠서비스(Coupang Eats Services)는 Delivery service에 대한 차별화 전략을 세우고, 쿠팡이츠의 고객, 상점주, 그리고 배달파트너들에게 한층 더 강화된 서비스와 지원을 제공하고 있습니다. 쿠팡이츠서비스는 원하는 음식을 언제 어디서든 빠르고 안전하게 배달함으로써 고객에게 놀라운 고객 경험을 선사하고, 상점주에게는 주문부터 배달, 고객응대까지 제공하는 원스톱 서비스를 통해 안정적인 판매 기회를 확보할수 있는 시스템을 운영하고 있습니다. 여러 분야의 전문가로 구성된 쿠팡이츠서비스는 하나의 팀으로서 고객과 상점주, 배달파트너가 원하는 가치를 고민하고 연구하며, 새로운 혁신과 패러다임 변화를 이끌어가고 있습니다.

직무 소개

쿠팡이츠서비스 Business & Operations 부문의 Director II, Program Management 는 Operational Excellence 조직을 리드하며 Delivery Operation 운영 전략 수립 및 실행, Operation 최적화, Supply Chain 관리, 고객 경험 개선 등 쿠팡이츠서비스의 핵심 운영 프로세스를 리드합니다. 데이터 기반의 실행력과 고객 중심의 사고역량을 통해 End-to-End 운영 효율성을 극대화해 고객 만족도를 높이는 데 중점을 둡니다.

업무 내용

  • Coupang Eats 딜리버리 운영의 혁신을 주도하며, 운영 표준화를 구축하고 계획 기반 실행을 강화
  • Crowd Sourcing 기반의 Rider Pool 운영 전략을 수립하여 Supply Chain 효율성을 최적화
  • 운영 전반에 대한 심층 분석을 바탕으로 프로세스 개선 및 자동화·디지털화 전략을 실행
  • KPI 기반 성과를 분석하고 데이터 중심의 전략적 인사이트를 도출하여 의사결정을 지원
  • Delivery Operation 운영 및 기획 조직을 이끌며, 인재 채용, 육성, 평가 등 조직 전반의 리더십을 수행

자격 요건

  • Delivery Operation, Strategy, Business Analysis 의 15년 이상 경력을 보유하신 분
  • 대규모 운영팀 또는 전사 레벨의 프로젝트를 성공적으로 리딩해 보신 분
  • 복잡하고 어려운 문제를 구조화하고 해결할 수 있는 역량과 역량을 보유하신 분
  • 문제를 해결하기 위한 initiatives를 수립하고 Output을 개선해 본 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 빠른 의사결정과 실행 중심의 리더십으로 에자일한 조직을 이끌어 보신 분
  • 프로덕트/테크/비즈니스 팀 및 외부 파트너사와의 협업을 주도적으로 이끌어 보신 분

우대 사항

  • 푸드 딜리버리/ 라이드 헤일링/ 이커머스 SCM/ 라스트 마일 서비스에서 운영 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 스타트업 등의 성장하는 기업에서 에자일하고 메트릭한 조직을 리딩해 보신 분
쿠팡이츠서비스 리더십 문화 (Leadership Principles)
  • Think Systemically: 전체 프로세스를 이해하고 시스템적 개선을 주도
  • Dive Deep: 문제의 근본 원인을 파악하고 개선 기회를 도출
  • Move with Urgency: 실행에 집중하며 민첩하게 개선
  • Wow the Customer: 고객 경험을 최우선에 두는 전략적 실행

전형 절차 및안내사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 - 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

jobs.title: Director, Program Management (Retail Catalog Quality Excellence)
jobs.description:
회사 소개

쿠팡 주식회사(Coupang Corp.)는 미국 시애틀에 본사를 둔 포춘 150대 글로벌 기술 기업 Coupang, Inc. (NYSE: CPNG)의 한국 자회사입니다. 한국의 2,500만 명이 넘는 활성 고객에게 서비스를 제공하며, 쿠팡, 로켓배송, 쿠팡이츠, 쿠팡플레이, 쿠팡페이를 통해 고객의 일상에 밀접한 상품과 서비스를 선보이고 있습니다. 자체 AI 및 엔지니어링 역량, 통합 풀필먼트·물류 인프라를 바탕으로 대규모의 복잡한 문제를 빠르게 해결합니다. 매일 수많은 고객의 다음 일상을 만들어가는 여정에 함께할 인재를 기다립니다. 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

Director, Program Management (Retail Catalog Quality Excellence) 포지션은, 대규모 1P Retail 비즈니스 전반의 상품 카탈로그 품질 전략 및 운영을 총괄합니다. 수백만 개 이상의 SKU를 대상으로 카탈로그 품질 기준과 데이터 거버넌스 체계를 구축하고, 전사 품질 혁신 프로그램을 리드하며, Product, Engineering, Business, Operations 조직과 협력하여 고객이 신뢰할 수 있는 상품 정보 경험을 만들어갑니다.

업무 내용

  • 핵심 상품 메타데이터(속성, 브랜드, 이미지, 타이틀, 카테고리 등)에 대한 품질 기준과 정책을 수립함
  • Catalog Defect 정의와 품질 KPI/SLA 체계를 설계하고 지속 가능한 데이터 거버넌스 프레임워크를 구축·운영함
  • 카탈로그 품질 향상을 위한 중장기 전략 로드맵을 수립하고 경영진 핵심 아젠다와 연계된 전략 과제를 추진함
  • Defect Detection, Audit, Cleansing 및 업무 프로세스 개선 프로그램을 리딩하여 운영 효율과 고객 경험을 제고함
  • Product, Engineering, Business, Operations 등 유관 조직 간 협업 체계를 구축하고 전사 수준의 합의와 실행력을 확보함
  • 대규모 품질 이슈 해결을 위한 우선순위를 설정하고 전반적인 실행을 리딩함
  • 데이터 분석 기반으로 결함 원인과 품질 지표를 상시 모니터링하고, 시스템과 자동화를 활용한 확장 가능한 품질 관리 체계를 설계함

자격 요건

  • 이커머스·플랫폼 및 관련 데이터·운영 조직에서 12년 이상의 경력과 최소 5년 이상의 조직 또는 대규모 프로그램 리딩 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 수백만 SKU 규모의 상품 데이터 품질 관리, 메타데이터 표준화 및 데이터 거버넌스 구축 경험을 보유하신 분
  • Catalog Defect 정의와 품질 측정 체계를 설계하여 실질적인 비즈니스 임팩트를 창출하신 분
  • SQL, Python 등 데이터 분석 역량을 바탕으로 Product, Engineering, Business, Operations 조직과 협업하여 복잡한 문제를 해결하신 분
  • 한국어와 영어로 원활한 비즈니스 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분

우대 사항

  • AI/ML, LLM, 자동화 기술을 활용해 대규모 데이터 품질 개선 및 결함 탐지 시스템을 구축하신 분
  • 글로벌·크로스보더 또는 1P 리테일 밸류체인에 대한 깊은 이해를 바탕으로 카탈로그 표준화 및 품질 전환을 주도하신 분
  • 데이터 품질 및 표준화 과제의 방향성과 성과를 C-Level 경영진 관점으로 구조화해 보고하고 정렬을 이끌어내신 분

전형 절차 및안내사항

  • 전형절차

    • 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

  • 참고사항

    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

서류반환 정책

jobs.title: Director, Program Management (SMB Seller Growth & Success)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Company Introduction
We exist to wow our customers. We know we're doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, "How did I ever live without Coupang?" Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we are collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry from the ground up and establishing an unparalleled reputation for being leading and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Role Overview
This role is responsible for driving growth and success across a portfolio of emerging Rocket Growth sellers focusing on SMB Seller Growth & Success. You will combine data-driven insights, seller engagement strategies, educational initiatives, and cross-functional collaboration to improve seller performance, retention, and program adoption. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, customer-obsessed, and passionate about helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses through scalable solutions.

What You Will Do
• Own growth outcomes for a portfolio of Rocket Growth sellers by driving sales, assortment expansion, selection quality, and operational performance improvements.
• Analyze seller performance, business trends, and funnel metrics to identify growth opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver data-driven recommendations that accelerate seller success.
• Drive seller adoption, retention, and engagement across Rocket Growth programs, tools, and capabilities through targeted growth strategies and lifecycle management.
• Design, execute, and optimize scalable growth initiatives, educational programs, and enablement campaigns that increase seller performance across large seller populations.
• Develop reporting frameworks, dashboards, and experimentation methodologies to measure growth, adoption, retention, and overall business impact while continuously improving program effectiveness.
• Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Operations, Analytics, and Business Development teams to remove seller friction, influence roadmap priorities, and improve the end-to-end seller experience.
• Represent the voice of emerging sellers across the organization while leveraging automation, self-service tools, and scalable mechanisms to drive long-term growth and operational efficiency.

Basic Qualifications
• 15–20 years of experience in seller management
• Proven track record of building brands and securing high-impact media visibility
• Strong storytelling, writing, and executive communication skills
• Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments
• Background in corporate communications is highly desirable

Preferred Qualifications
• E-commerce or marketplace & platform businesses is a plus
• Working experience in a multinational company with exposure to Asia

Recruitment Process and Others

Recruitment Process
• Application Review - Job Fit Interview - Focus Interview – Offer
• The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary according to the specific job and may be changed due to scheduling or other circumstances.
• Interview schedules and the results will be informed to the applicant via the e-mail address submitted at the application stage.

Details to Consider
• This job posting may be closed prior to the stated end date for application if all openings are filled.
• Coupang has the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process.
• Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran's benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws.
• Job titles and responsibilities may be subject to change depending on the candidate's overall experience, etc. This will be communicated to the candidate at the appropriate time before the offer.
• Hiring may be restricted in case the legal qualifications required for hiring and work performance is not met.
• This is a full-time regular position and includes 12 weeks of probation period; provided, however, the probationary period may be either skipped, shortened or extended if necessary for business purposes.

Privacy Notice
• Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below. https://privacy.coupang.com/en/land/jobs/

Document Return Policy (This notice MUST be included in a job posting in Korea only to comply with the Fair Hiring Procedure Act.)
1. This notification is given pursuant to Article 11 (6) of the Fair Hiring Procedure Act.
2. A job applicant, who has applied but not been finally selected for a position at Coupang (the "Company"), may request the Company to return his/her hiring documents submitted pursuant to the Fair Hiring Procedure Act. However, this will not apply where the hiring documents were submitted via the website of the Company or e-mail, or where the job applicant submitted those documents voluntarily without a request from the Company. In addition, if the hiring documents were destroyed due to a natural disaster or any other reasons not attributable to the Company, such documents will be deemed to have been returned to the job applicant.
3. A job applicant who wishes to request the return of his/her hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above should fill out a "Request for Return of Hiring Documents" [Annex Form No. 3 in the Enforcement Rule of the Fair Hiring Procedure Act] and submit It by email (recruitingops@coupang.com). In such case, within fourteen (14) days from the date of identifying the receipt of the request, the Company will send the hiring documents to the job applicant's designated address via registered mail. Please be informed that the job applicant is required to pay the postage on the registered mail.
4. In preparation for a job applicant's request for the return of hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above, the Company shall retain the original hiring documents submitted by the job applicant for 180 days from the completion of the recruiting process. If no request is made until the end of this period, all his/her hiring documents will be destroyed immediately in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act.
5. The above paragraphs 1 - 4 shall only apply when the labor-related laws of Korea govern the application. They are otherwise not applicable.

jobs.title: Director, Sales Strategy & Planning | Rocket Growth
jobs.description:
Location: Seoul, South Korea
Job Type: Full-time

About Coupang

At Coupang, we exist to wow our customers. Our mission is to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever before. We’re disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry from the ground up and building a reputation as South Korea’s most innovative and reliable e-commerce platform.

We combine the agility of a startup with the scale and resources of a global public company. This unique blend empowers us to launch new services at speed, drive innovation, and make a tangible impact every day. At Coupang, you’ll grow alongside bold, hands-on, and ambitious teammates who are passionate about shaping the future of commerce.

On Rocket Growth (RG):

Rocket Growth is a dynamic business unit focused on driving innovation, scale, and strategic growth across emerging markets and categories. We are building a brand that stands for bold thinking, transformative impact, and future-forward leadership.

A. Sales Planning & Performance Management

  • Strategic Planning: Act as the primary planning partner to designated Category Leaders, coordinating and driving the annual, quarterly, and ongoing sales planning processes.

  • Goal Setting & Tracking: Establish and maintain robust performance tracking mechanisms (KPIs, OKRs) to monitor category sales execution against strategic objectives.

  • Deep-Dive Analysis: Conduct detailed, hypothesis-driven analysis of sales performance, market trends, and category performance to identify risks, opportunities, and areas for optimization.

B. Strategic Storytelling & Executive Presentation

  • Narrative Development: Design and build compelling, clear, and concise strategic 'storylines' and presentations for consumption by Sales Leadership and Executive Management.

  • Executive Readouts: Present key findings, strategic recommendations, and performance summaries with conviction, translating complex planning and tracking data into actionable business insights.

  • Rapid-Turnaround: Leverage a 'management consulting' mindset to quickly synthesize complex information and transform it into highly polished, presentation-ready formats under tight deadlines.

C. Team Leadership & Asset Scalability

  • Team Management: Manage, coach, and develop a team of Analysts/Planners, ensuring high quality and consistency in their analytical outputs.

  • Scalable Solutions: Lead the team in the development and implementation of reusable, automated, and scalable planning and tracking assets (e.g., dashboards, templates, data models).

  • Sales Enablement: Drive the transition toward a 'self-serve' data model, enabling the broader sales team to access performance data and tracking insights directly and efficiently.

II. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 10-15 years of professional experience in Sales Operations, Business Planning, Strategy, or a related analytical function, preferably supporting a high-intensity, fast-paced Sales organization.

  • Structure & Detail: Demonstrated history of being highly structured and meticulous in planning, execution, and documentation.

  • Analytical Skills: Advanced proficiency in data analysis and modeling (e.g., Excel, SQL, Tableau/Power BI) and the ability to derive strategic insights from large datasets.

  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to summarize complex issues into a crisp, consumable storyline for executive audiences.

III. Preferred Qualifications

  • Management Consulting: Prior experience at a top-tier management consulting firm is a strong advantage.

  • Team Leadership: Experience managing or mentoring analytical staff.

  • Tool Proficiency: Expertise in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), planning tools, and Business Intelligence platforms (Tableau).

    • Interview schedules and the results will be informed to the applicant via the e-mail address submitted at the application stage.

    Things to Consider

    • Coupang has the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process.
    • Coupang does not discriminate against disabled applicants or those with veteran status. We are proud to offer equal opportunities for all applicants.

jobs.title: [쿠팡로지스틱스서비스] Director, SCM Process Innovation
jobs.description:
회사 소개

CLS는 국토교통부로 지정받은 택배 운송 사업자로서 전국 단위의 배송 캠프에서 업계 최초로 도입한 분류작업 전담 인력과 직영 전문 배송직 쿠팡친구, 그리고 전국 단위 택배 영업점을 통해 고객에게 최적의 배송 서비스를 제공하면서 쿠팡의 로켓배송을 완결하는 역할을 담당하고 있습니다.

로켓배송을 통해 미래 물류의 혁신을 이끌어 온 종합물류서비스 기업으로서 CLS는 로켓배송의 노하우, 인프라, 네트워크 등을 연계하여 물류 혁신을 통한 더 나은 고객감동을 만들어 나갈 것입니다.

직무 소개

Coupang의 물류 네트워크는 전진형 물류 센터 거점 구조로 고객 감동을 빠르게 확장하고 있습니다.
해당 포지션은 SCM 관점에서 재고 배치 최적화, 센터 간 이관 전략, 그리고 E2E 공급망 관리를 지향하며, Rocket 배송과 다양한 배송 서비스의 원가 경쟁력과 고객 경험을 결정짓는 핵심 의사결정을 리드합니다.

또한, Logistics Supply Chain Innovation 조직 전체의 전략 방향을 설정하고, 물류, Finance, Tech, Retail, Operation 등 내,외부 유관 조직과의 얼라인을 통해 Coupang 물류 혁신 로드맵을 실행합니다.

업무 내용

1. Inventory Strategy & Optimization

  • 전진형 중소형 물류센터와 보충센터의 재고 보관 최적화 전략 수립 및 실행
  • Network 재고 총량/회전율·DOC(Days of Coverage) 목표 관리
  • 센터 간 이관(Transfer) 전략 설계 및 재고 건전성 프로그램 총괄

2. Fulfillment Operations Innovation

  • IB / Transfer 전 영역의 Capacity Planning 및 Bottleneck 해소
  • Peak Season 대응 Plan 수립 및 실행 리드
  • Supply Chain 관점의 결품 최소화 및 재고 흐름 최적화

3. ICQA (Inventory Control and Quality Assurance)

  • 오류의 근본 원인 분석 및 검증(DMAIC)을 통한 품질 개선 & 재고 결함 감소 활동
  • SBC, CC 등 재고 조사 기법을 통한 사전 예방 관리 감독
  • SOP 수립 및 관리 감독

4. Cross-functional Leadership

  • FC Ops, Retail, Tech, Finance와의 협업 체계 구축
  • 내,외부 조직 간의 협업 체계 구축
  • VP 레벨 Mitigation·Escalation 이슈 대응 및 의사결정 지원
  • 신규 PICO(Pallet In Case Out) 센터 재고 배치 전략 설계 및 Go-live 협업

자격 요건

  • 학사 이상 & 물류·이커머스·제조업의 SCM/Operations 분야 15년 이상 경력
  • 조직 관리 경험 보유
  • E2E Supply Chain Management(Vendor - FC - Last-mile) 전 영역에 대한 깊은 이해
  • Agile 운영 환경에서 Lean, Six Sigma(DMAIC) 방법론을 적용한 프로세스 개선 및 리딩 경험

우대 사항

  • Data-driven 의사결정 및 SQL·BI Tool 활용에 대한 이해
  • Industrial Engineering, Business 등 물류 관련 전공 학사
  • IE(SCM, Operations Research, Quality), Business 석/박사
  • English business proficiency (Global 협업 필수)

전형 절차 및안내사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

jobs.title: Director, Search Marketing
jobs.description:
About the Role

Coupang is looking for a Director of Search Marketing to lead the search marketing portfolio and drive business performance across GMV, spend, efficiency, forecasting, and budget allocation.

This is a senior leadership role for a balanced performance marketing leader who combines strong commercial judgment with technical fluency. The ideal candidate understands search marketing at scale, can guide bidding and automation strategy, and can work effectively with engineering, ML, data science, and analytics teams. This leader will also manage a high-performing team and communicate search marketing performance clearly to senior leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Drive Search Marketing Business Performance

  • Lead business performance for the search marketing portfolio across GMV, spend, efficiency, forecasting, and budget allocation.
  • Translate company growth goals into channel-level targets, investment plans, and execution priorities.
  • Balance growth, efficiency, spend constraints, and long-term channel health.

Lead Channel Strategy and Execution

  • Oversee performance across major search and shopping platforms, including Naver and Google.
  • Guide strategy across Ads, Shopping, and other search-led growth surfaces.
  • Set priorities across campaigns, keywords, placements, product/feed inputs, and optimization opportunities.

Advance Bidding, Measurement, and Automation

  • Apply strong understanding of bidding frameworks, auction dynamics, automated bidding, ROAS, marginal ROI, and budget elasticity.
  • Partner with ML, engineering, data science, and analytics teams to improve bidding systems, measurement, forecasting, and diagnostics.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work through automation, tooling, rules, and scalable operating processes.

Communicate and Influence Across the Business

  • Present performance, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.
  • Build concise, numbers-backed narratives that explain business performance and required actions.
  • Collaborate closely with Finance, Engineering, ML/Data Science, Analytics, Product, Legal, and external platform partners.

Lead and Develop the Team

  • Lead a team of search marketing professionals responsible for channel and placement-level execution.
  • Set clear goals, operating cadence, priorities, and accountability across the team.
  • Coach the team to improve analytical depth, technical fluency, business judgment, and communication quality.

Basic Qualifications

  • Significant experience leading search marketing, performance marketing, growth marketing, or paid media at scale.
  • Proven ownership of large-scale commercial outcomes such as GMV, revenue, spend, ROAS, ROI, margin, or equivalent business performance metrics.
